<h1 id="vimeo">Vimeo v3.4</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://api.vimeo.com">https://api.vimeo.com</a> - Vimeo.com

Web: <a href="https://developer.vimeo.com/help">https://developer.vimeo.com/help</a> 

# Authentication

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer

- oAuth2 authentication.

    - Flow: authorizationCode
    - Authorization URL = [/oauth/authorize](/oauth/authorize)
    - Token URL = [/oauth/access_token](/oauth/access_token)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|create|Create new albums, channels, and so on|
|delete|Delete videos, albums, channels, and so on|
|edit|Edit existing videos, albums, channels, and so on|
|email|Access to email addresses|
|interact|Interact with Vimeo resources on a member's behalf, such as liking a video or following another member|
|private|Access private member data|
|promo_codes|Add, remove, and review Vimeo On Demand promotions|
|public|Access public member data|
|purchase|Purchase content|
|purchased|Access a member's Vimeo On Demand purchase history|
|stats|Access video stats|
|upload|Upload videos|
|video_files|Access video files belonging to members with a PRO subscription or higher|

    - Flow: clientCredentials
    - Token URL = [/oauth/authorize/client](/oauth/authorize/client)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|create|Create new albums, channels, and so on|
|delete|Delete videos, albums, channels, and so on|
|edit|Edit existing videos, albums, channels, and so on|
|email|Access to email addresses|
|interact|Interact with Vimeo resources on a member's behalf, such as liking a video or following another member|
|private|Access private member data|
|promo_codes|Add, remove, and review Vimeo On Demand promotions|
|public|Access public member data|
|purchase|Purchase content|
|purchased|Access a member's Vimeo On Demand purchase history|
|stats|Access video stats|
|upload|Upload videos|
|video_files|Access video files belonging to members with a PRO subscription or higher|

<h1 id="vimeo-api-information">API Information</h1>

## Get an API specification

<a id="opIdget_endpoints"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.endpoint+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /`

<h3 id="get-an-api-specification-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|openapi|query|boolean|false|Return an OpenAPI specification.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "methods": [
    "string"
  ],
  "path": "/me"
}
```

<h3 id="get-an-api-specification-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Standard request.|[endpoint](#schemaendpoint)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

<h1 id="vimeo-albumsalbum-videos">Albums\Album videos</h1>

## Get all the videos in an album

<a id="opIdget_album_videos_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/albums/3706071/videos \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/albums/{album_id}/videos`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-an-album-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|album_id|path|number|true|The ID of the album.|
|containing_uri|query|string|false|The page containing the video URI.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|filter_embeddable|query|boolean|false|Whether to filter the results by embeddable videos (`true`) or non-embeddable videos (`false`). Required only if **filter** is `embeddable`.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|password|query|string|false|The password of the album.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|
|weak_search|query|boolean|false|Whether to include private videos in the search. Please note that a separate search service provides this functionality. The service performs a partial text search on the video's name.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|filter|embeddable|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|comments|
|sort|date|
|sort|default|
|sort|duration|
|sort|likes|
|sort|manual|
|sort|modified_time|
|sort|plays|

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-an-album-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|No such album exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-an-album-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Replace all the videos in an album

<a id="opIdreplace_videos_in_album_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/albums/3706071/videos \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "videos": "/videos/258684937,/videos/273576296"
  }'
```

`PUT /me/albums/{album_id}/videos`

This method replaces all the existing videos in an album with one or more videos.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "videos": "/videos/258684937,/videos/273576296"
}
```

<h3 id="replace-all-the-videos-in-an-album-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|album_id|path|number|true|The ID of the album.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» videos|body|string|true|A comma-separated list of video URIs.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="replace-all-the-videos-in-an-album-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|The videos were added.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user can't add videos to albums.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such album exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

## Get a specific video in an album

<a id="opIdget_album_video_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/albums/3706071/videos/196367152 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/albums/{album_id}/videos/{video_id}`

This method gets a single video from an album. You can use this method to determine whether the album contains the specified video.

<h3 id="get-a-specific-video-in-an-album-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|album_id|path|number|true|The ID of the album.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|password|query|string|false|The password of the album.|

## Add a specific video to an album

<a id="opIdadd_video_to_album_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/albums/12345/videos/196367152 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /me/albums/{album_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="add-a-specific-video-to-an-album-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|album_id|path|number|true|The ID of the album.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-specific-video-to-an-album-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was added.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The supplied token doesn't have the proper scopes, or the authenticated user can't edit the album.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such album exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

## Set a video as the album thumbnail

<a id="opIdset_video_as_album_thumbnail_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/albums/12345/videos/196367152/set_album_thumbnail \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "time_code": 300
  }'
```

`POST /me/albums/{album_id}/videos/{video_id}/set_album_thumbnail`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "time_code": 300
}
```

<h3 id="set-a-video-as-the-album-thumbnail-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|album_id|path|number|true|The ID of the album.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» time_code|body|number|false|The video frame time in seconds to use as the album thumbnail.|

## Get all the videos in an album

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/albums/3706071/videos \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/albums/{album_id}/videos`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-an-album-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|No such album exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-an-album-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Replace all the videos in an album

<a id="opIdreplace_videos_in_album"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/albums/3706071/videos \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "videos": "/videos/258684937,/videos/273576296"
  }'
```

`PUT /users/{user_id}/albums/{album_id}/videos`

This method replaces all the existing videos in an album with one or more videos.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "videos": "/videos/258684937,/videos/273576296"
}
```

<h3 id="replace-all-the-videos-in-an-album-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|album_id|path|number|true|The ID of the album.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» videos|body|string|true|A comma-separated list of video URIs.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="replace-all-the-videos-in-an-album-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|The videos were added.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user can't add videos to albums.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such album exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

## Get a specific video in an album

<a id="opIdget_album_video"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/albums/3706071/videos/196367152 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/albums/{album_id}/videos/{video_id}`

This method gets a single video from an album. You can use this method to determine whether the album contains the specified video.

<h3 id="get-a-specific-video-in-an-album-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|album_id|path|number|true|The ID of the album.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|password|query|string|false|The password of the album.|

## Add a specific video to an album


`PUT /users/{user_id}/albums/{album_id}/videos/{video_id}`

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|album_id|path|number|true|The ID of the album.|

|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

## Set a video as the album thumbnail

<a id="opIdset_video_as_album_thumbnail"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/albums/12345/videos/196367152/set_album_thumbnail \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "time_code": 300
  }'
```

`POST /users/{user_id}/albums/{album_id}/videos/{video_id}/set_album_thumbnail`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "time_code": 300
}
```

<h3 id="set-a-video-as-the-album-thumbnail-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|album_id|path|number|true|The ID of the album.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» time_code|body|number|false|The video frame time in seconds to use as the album thumbnail.|

## Create an album

<a id="opIdcreate_album_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/albums \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.album+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.album+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "brand_color": "ff66ee",
    "description": "Vimeo holiday videos!",
    "hide_nav": "true",
    "layout": "grid",
    "name": "Vimeo Holiday Videos!",
    "password": "hunter1",
    "privacy": "anybody",
    "review_mode": "true",
    "sort": "added_first",
    "theme": "dark"
  }'
```

`POST /me/albums`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "brand_color": "ff66ee",
  "description": "Vimeo holiday videos!",
  "hide_nav": "true",
  "layout": "grid",
  "name": "Vimeo Holiday Videos!",
  "password": "hunter1",
  "privacy": "anybody",
  "review_mode": "true",
  "sort": "added_first",
  "theme": "dark"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-album-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» brand_color|body|string|false|The hexadecimal code for the color of the player buttons.|
|» description|body|string|false|The description of the album.|
|» hide_nav|body|boolean|false|Whether to hide Vimeo navigation when displaying the album.|
|» layout|body|string|false|The type of layout for presenting the album.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the album.|
|» password|body|string|false|The album's password. Required only if **privacy** is `password`.|
|» privacy|body|string|false|The privacy level of the album.|
|» review_mode|body|boolean|false|Whether album videos should use the review mode URL.|
|» sort|body|string|false|The default sort order of the album's videos.|
|» theme|body|string|false|The color theme of the album.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» layout|grid|
|» layout|player|
|» privacy|anybody|
|» privacy|embed_only|
|» privacy|password|
|» sort|added_first|
|» sort|added_last|
|» sort|alphabetical|
|» sort|arranged|
|» sort|comments|
|» sort|likes|
|» sort|newest|
|» sort|oldest|
|» sort|plays|
|» theme|dark|
|» theme|standard|

## Delete an album

<a id="opIddelete_album_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/albums/3706071 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /me/albums/{album_id}`

<h3 id="delete-an-album-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|album_id|path|number|true|The ID of the album.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="delete-an-album-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The album was deleted.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The supplied token doesn't have the proper scopes, or the authenticated user can't delete the album.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such album exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: delete )
</aside>

## Edit an album

<a id="opIdedit_album_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/albums/3706071 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.album+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.album+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "brand_color": "ff66ee",
    "description": "Vimeo holiday videos!",
    "domain": "mycustomdomain.com",
    "hide_nav": "true",
    "layout": "grid",
    "name": "Vimeo Holiday Videos!",
    "password": "hunter1",
    "privacy": "anybody",
    "review_mode": "true",
    "sort": "added_first",
    "theme": "dark",
    "url": "my-custom-url",
    "use_custom_domain": "true"
  }'
```

`PATCH /me/albums/{album_id}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "brand_color": "ff66ee",
  "description": "Vimeo holiday videos!",
  "domain": "mycustomdomain.com",
  "hide_nav": "true",
  "layout": "grid",
  "name": "Vimeo Holiday Videos!",
  "password": "hunter1",
  "privacy": "anybody",
  "review_mode": "true",
  "sort": "added_first",
  "theme": "dark",
  "url": "my-custom-url",
  "use_custom_domain": "true"
}
```

<h3 id="edit-an-album-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|album_id|path|number|true|The ID of the album.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» brand_color|body|string|false|The hexadecimal code for the color of the player buttons.|
|» description|body|string|false|The description of the album.|
|» domain|body|string \| null|false|The custom domain a user has selected for their album.|
|» hide_nav|body|boolean|false|Whether to hide Vimeo navigation when displaying the album.|
|» layout|body|string|false|The type of layout for presenting the album.|
|» name|body|string|false|The name of the album.|
|» password|body|string|false|The album's password. Required only if **privacy** is `password`.|
|» privacy|body|string|false|The privacy level of the album.|
|» review_mode|body|boolean|false|Whether album videos should use the review mode URL.|
|» sort|body|string|false|The default sort order of the album's videos.|
|» theme|body|string|false|The color theme of the album.|
|» url|body|string \| null|false|The custom Vimeo URL a user has selected for their album.|
|» use_custom_domain|body|boolean|false|Whether the user has opted in to use a custom domain for their album.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» layout|grid|
|» layout|player|
|» privacy|anybody|
|» privacy|embed_only|
|» privacy|password|
|» sort|added_first|
|» sort|added_last|
|» sort|alphabetical|
|» sort|arranged|
|» sort|comments|
|» sort|likes|
|» sort|newest|
|» sort|oldest|
|» sort|plays|
|» theme|dark|
|» theme|standard|

## Get all the albums that belong to a user

<a id="opIdget_albums"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/albums \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/albums`

<h3 id="get-all-the-albums-that-belong-to-a-user-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|date|
|sort|duration|
|sort|videos|

## Create an album

<a id="opIdcreate_album"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/albums \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.album+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.album+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "brand_color": "ff66ee",
    "description": "Vimeo holiday videos!",
    "hide_nav": "true",
    "layout": "grid",
    "name": "Vimeo Holiday Videos!",
    "password": "hunter1",
    "privacy": "anybody",
    "review_mode": "true",
    "sort": "added_first",
    "theme": "dark"
  }'
```

`POST /users/{user_id}/albums`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "brand_color": "ff66ee",
  "description": "Vimeo holiday videos!",
  "hide_nav": "true",
  "layout": "grid",
  "name": "Vimeo Holiday Videos!",
  "password": "hunter1",
  "privacy": "anybody",
  "review_mode": "true",
  "sort": "added_first",
  "theme": "dark"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-album-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» brand_color|body|string|false|The hexadecimal code for the color of the player buttons.|
|» description|body|string|false|The description of the album.|
|» hide_nav|body|boolean|false|Whether to hide Vimeo navigation when displaying the album.|
|» layout|body|string|false|The type of layout for presenting the album.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the album.|
|» password|body|string|false|The album's password. Required only if **privacy** is `password`.|
|» privacy|body|string|false|The privacy level of the album.|
|» review_mode|body|boolean|false|Whether album videos should use the review mode URL.|
|» sort|body|string|false|The default sort order of the album's videos.|
|» theme|body|string|false|The color theme of the album.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» layout|grid|
|» layout|player|
|» privacy|anybody|
|» privacy|embed_only|
|» privacy|password|
|» sort|added_first|
|» sort|added_last|
|» sort|alphabetical|
|» sort|arranged|
|» sort|comments|
|» sort|likes|
|» sort|newest|
|» sort|oldest|
|» sort|plays|
|» theme|dark|
|» theme|standard|

## Edit an album

<a id="opIdedit_album"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/albums/3706071 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.album+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.album+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "brand_color": "ff66ee",
    "description": "Vimeo holiday videos!",
    "domain": "mycustomdomain.com",
    "hide_nav": "true",
    "layout": "grid",
    "name": "Vimeo Holiday Videos!",
    "password": "hunter1",
    "privacy": "anybody",
    "review_mode": "true",
    "sort": "added_first",
    "theme": "dark",
    "url": "my-custom-url",
    "use_custom_domain": "true"
  }'
```

`PATCH /users/{user_id}/albums/{album_id}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "brand_color": "ff66ee",
  "description": "Vimeo holiday videos!",
  "domain": "mycustomdomain.com",
  "hide_nav": "true",
  "layout": "grid",
  "name": "Vimeo Holiday Videos!",
  "password": "hunter1",
  "privacy": "anybody",
  "review_mode": "true",
  "sort": "added_first",
  "theme": "dark",
  "url": "my-custom-url",
  "use_custom_domain": "true"
}
```

<h3 id="edit-an-album-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|album_id|path|number|true|The ID of the album.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» brand_color|body|string|false|The hexadecimal code for the color of the player buttons.|
|» description|body|string|false|The description of the album.|
|» domain|body|string \| null|false|The custom domain a user has selected for their album.|
|» hide_nav|body|boolean|false|Whether to hide Vimeo navigation when displaying the album.|
|» layout|body|string|false|The type of layout for presenting the album.|
|» name|body|string|false|The name of the album.|
|» password|body|string|false|The album's password. Required only if **privacy** is `password`.|
|» privacy|body|string|false|The privacy level of the album.|
|» review_mode|body|boolean|false|Whether album videos should use the review mode URL.|
|» sort|body|string|false|The default sort order of the album's videos.|
|» theme|body|string|false|The color theme of the album.|
|» url|body|string \| null|false|The custom Vimeo URL a user has selected for their album.|
|» use_custom_domain|body|boolean|false|Whether the user has opted in to use a custom domain for their album.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» layout|grid|
|» layout|player|
|» privacy|anybody|
|» privacy|embed_only|
|» privacy|password|
|» sort|added_first|
|» sort|added_last|
|» sort|alphabetical|
|» sort|arranged|
|» sort|comments|
|» sort|likes|
|» sort|newest|
|» sort|oldest|
|» sort|plays|
|» theme|dark|
|» theme|standard|

<h1 id="vimeo-authentication-extrasessentials">Authentication Extras\Essentials</h1>

## Exchange an authorization code for an access token

<a id="opIdexchange_auth_code"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/oauth/access_token \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.auth+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.auth+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "code": "1234abcd",
    "grant_type": "authorization_code",
    "redirect_uri": "https://example.com"
  }'
```

`POST /oauth/access_token`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "code": "1234abcd",
  "grant_type": "authorization_code",
  "redirect_uri": "https://example.com"
}
```

<h3 id="exchange-an-authorization-code-for-an-access-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» code|body|string|true|The authorization code received from the authorization server.|
|» grant_type|body|string|true|The grant type. Must be set to `authorization_code`.|
|» redirect_uri|body|string|true|The redirect URI. Must match the URI from `/oauth/authorize`.|

#### Enumerated Values

## Authorize a client with OAuth

<a id="opIdclient_auth"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/oauth/authorize/client \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.auth+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.auth+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "grant_type": "client_credentials",
    "scope": "public"
  }'
```

`POST /oauth/authorize/client`

For information on utilizing OAuth client authorization, see our
[authentication](/api/authentication#generate-unauthenticated-tokens) documentation or the
[Client Credentials Grant](https://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-31#section-4.4) section of the
[OAuth spec](https://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-31.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "grant_type": "client_credentials",
  "scope": "public"
}
```

<h3 id="authorize-a-client-with-oauth-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» grant_type|body|string|true|The grant type. Must be set to `client_credentials`.|
|» scope|body|string|true|A space-separated list of the authentication [scopes](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/authentication#supported-scopes) that you want to access. The default is `public`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» grant_type|client_credentials|

## Convert OAuth 1 access tokens to OAuth 2 access tokens

<a id="opIdconvert_access_token"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/oauth/authorize/vimeo_oauth1 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.auth+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.auth+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "grant_type": "vimeo_oauth1",
    "token": "58037c0078d5f54e15e638cc0dd882a570b13c50",
    "token_secret": "NTgwMzdjMDA3OGQ1ZjU0ZTE1ZTYzOGNjMGRkODgyYTU3MGIxM2M1MA=="
  }'
```

`POST /oauth/authorize/vimeo_oauth1`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "grant_type": "vimeo_oauth1",
  "token": "58037c0078d5f54e15e638cc0dd882a570b13c50",
  "token_secret": "NTgwMzdjMDA3OGQ1ZjU0ZTE1ZTYzOGNjMGRkODgyYTU3MGIxM2M1MA=="
}
```

<h3 id="convert-oauth-1-access-tokens-to-oauth-2-access-tokens-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» grant_type|body|string|true|The grant type. Must be set to `vimeo_oauth1`.|
|» token|body|string|true|The OAuth 1 token.|
|» token_secret|body|string|true|The OAuth 1 token secret.|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» grant_type|vimeo_oauth1|

<h3 id="convert-oauth-1-access-tokens-to-oauth-2-access-tokens-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The tokens were converted.|[auth](#schemaauth)|
|400|Bad Request|* The token is invalid.<br>* The token has unauthorized scopes.|[auth-error](#schemaauth-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Revoke the current access token

<a id="opIddelete_token"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/tokens \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.auth+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /tokens`

This method enables an app to notify the API that it is done with a token and that the token can be discarded.

<h1 id="vimeo-categorieschannels">Categories\Channels</h1>

## Get all the channels in a category

<a id="opIdget_category_channels"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/categories/animation/channels \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.channel+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /categories/{category}/channels`

<h3 id="get-all-the-channels-in-a-category-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|category|path|string|true|The name of the category.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|date|
|sort|followers|
|sort|videos|

<h1 id="vimeo-categoriesessentials">Categories\Essentials</h1>

## Get all categories

<a id="opIdget_categories"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/categories \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.category+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /categories`

This method gets all existing categories.

<h3 id="get-all-categories-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort|last_video_featured_time|
|sort|name|


<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-category-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|No such category exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-category-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Check for a video in a category

<a id="opIdcheck_category_for_video"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/categories/animation/videos/273576296 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /categories/{category}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="check-for-a-video-in-a-category-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|category|path|string|true|The name of the category.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."

```

<h3 id="check-for-a-video-in-a-category-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The video belongs to the category.|[video](#schemavideo)|
|404|Not Found|No such category exists, or the video doesn't belong to it.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get all the categories to which a video belongs

<a id="opIdget_video_categories"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/categories \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.category+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /videos/{video_id}/categories`

<h3 id="get-all-the-categories-to-which-a-video-belongs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

## Create a channel

<a id="opIdcreate_channel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.channel+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.channel+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "We really love videos, and these are the videos we really, really love.",
    "link": "staffpicks",
    "name": "Vimeo Staff Picks",
    "privacy": "anybody"
  }'
```

`POST /channels`

This method creates a new channel.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "We really love videos, and these are the videos we really, really love.",
  "link": "staffpicks",
  "name": "Vimeo Staff Picks",
  "privacy": "anybody"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» description|body|string|false|The description of the channel.|
|» link|body|string|false|The link to access the channel. You can use a custom name in the URL in place of a numeric channel ID, as in `/channels/{url_custom}`.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the channel.|
|» privacy|body|string|true|The privacy level of the channel.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» privacy|anybody|
|» privacy|moderators|
|» privacy|user|

<h3 id="get-a-specific-channel-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The channel was returned.|[channel](#schemachannel)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Delete a channel

<a id="opIddelete_channel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /channels/{channel_id}`

<h3 id="delete-a-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="delete-a-channel-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The channel was deleted.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user doesn't own this channel.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: delete )
</aside>

## Edit a channel

<a id="opIdedit_channel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.channel+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.channel+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "We really love videos, and these are the videos we really, really love.",
    "link": "staffpicks",
    "name": "Vimeo Staff Picks",
    "privacy": "anybody"
  }'
```

`PATCH /channels/{channel_id}`

This method edits the specified channel.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "We really love videos, and these are the videos we really, really love.",
  "link": "staffpicks",
  "name": "Vimeo Staff Picks",
  "privacy": "anybody"
}
```

<h3 id="edit-a-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» description|body|string|false|The description of the channel.|
|» link|body|string|false|The link to access the channel. You can use a custom name in the URL in place of a numeric channel ID, as in `/channels/{url_custom}`. Submitting `""` for this field removes the link alias.|
|» name|body|string|false|The name of the channel.|
|» privacy|body|string|false|The privacy level of the channel.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» privacy|anybody|
|» privacy|moderators|
|» privacy|users|

## Get all the channels to which a user subscribes

<a id="opIdget_channel_subscriptions_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/channels \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.channel+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/channels`

<h3 id="get-all-the-channels-to-which-a-user-subscribes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|filter|moderated|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|date|
|sort|followers|
|sort|videos|

## Get all the channels to which a user subscribes

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/channels \
```

|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|

<h1 id="vimeo-channelsmoderators">Channels\Moderators</h1>

## Get all the moderators in a channel

<a id="opIdget_channel_moderators"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/moderators \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.user+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /channels/{channel_id}/moderators`

<h3 id="get-all-the-moderators-in-a-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|date|

## Add a list of channel moderators

<a id="opIdadd_channel_moderators"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/moderators \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "user_uri": "/users/152184"
  }'
```

`PUT /channels/{channel_id}/moderators`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "user_uri": "/users/152184"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-list-of-channel-moderators-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» user_uri|body|string|true|The URI of a user to add as a moderator.|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-list-of-channel-moderators-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The moderators were added.|None|
|400|Bad Request|Error code 2908: The list contains more than 100 users.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user doesn't own the channel, a user is already a moderator of the channel, or you tried to add a user that the authenticated user doesn't follow.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such channel exists, or no such user exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

```bash
  -d '{
```

## Permit a list of users to view a private channel

<a id="opIdset_channel_privacy_users"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/privacy/users \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.user+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.user+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "users": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /channels/{channel_id}/privacy/users`

This method gives multiple users access to the specified private channel.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "users": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|body|body|object|true|none|
|» users|body|[string]|true|The array of either the user URIs or the user IDs to permit to view the private channel.|

```bash

```

`GET /channels/{channel_id}/users`

<h3 id="get-all-the-followers-of-a-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-channel-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|
|304|Not Modified|No videos have been added to this channel since the given `If-Modified-Since` header.|None|
|400|Bad Request|The **sort** field is `default`, but the **direction** field has a value.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such channel exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-channel-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Add a list of videos to a channel

<a id="opIdadd_videos_to_channel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/videos \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "video_uri": "/videos/258684937"
  }'
```

`PUT /channels/{channel_id}/videos`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "video_uri": "/videos/258684937"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-list-of-videos-to-a-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» video_uri|body|string|true|The URI of a video to add.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-list-of-videos-to-a-channel-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were added.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user isn't a moderator of the channel, or the video can't be added to the channel.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such channel exists, or no such user exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

## Remove a list of videos from a channel

<a id="opIdremove_videos_from_channel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/videos \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "video_uri": "/videos/258684937"
  }'
```

`DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/videos`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "video_uri": "/videos/258684937"
}
```

<h3 id="remove-a-list-of-videos-from-a-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» video_uri|body|string|true|The URI of a video to remove.|

<h3 id="remove-a-list-of-videos-from-a-channel-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The videos were removed.|[video](#schemavideo)|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user isn't a moderator of this channel, or you can't remove this video from the channel.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such channel exists, or no such user exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

## Get a specific video in a channel

<a id="opIdget_channel_video"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/videos/258684937 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /channels/{channel_id}/videos/{video_id}`

This method returns a specific video in a channel. You can use it to determine whether the video is in the channel.

<h3 id="get-a-specific-video-in-a-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

## Add a specific video to a channel

<a id="opIdadd_video_to_channel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/videos/258684937 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /channels/{channel_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="add-a-specific-video-to-a-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-specific-video-to-a-channel-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was added.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The video can't be added to channels, or the authenticated user isn't the moderator of this channel.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such channel exists, or no such video exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/videos/258684937 \
```

`DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="remove-a-specific-video-from-a-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="remove-a-specific-video-from-a-channel-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was removed.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user isn't a moderator of this channel.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such channel exists, or no such video exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

## Edit an embed preset

<a id="opIdedit_embed_preset_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/presets/12345 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.preset+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.preset+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "outro": "nothing"
  }'
```

`PATCH /me/presets/{preset_id}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "outro": "nothing"
}
```

<h3 id="edit-an-embed-preset-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|preset_id|path|number|true|The ID of the preset.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» outro|body|string|false|Disable the outro.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» outro|nothing|

## Edit an embed preset

<a id="opIdedit_embed_preset"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/presets/12345 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.preset+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.preset+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "outro": "nothing"
  }'
```

`PATCH /users/{user_id}/presets/{preset_id}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "outro": "nothing"
}
```

<h3 id="edit-an-embed-preset-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|preset_id|path|number|true|The ID of the preset.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» outro|body|string|false|Disable the outro.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» outro|nothing|

<h1 id="vimeo-embed-presetsvideos">Embed Presets\Videos</h1>

## Get all the videos that have been added to an embed preset

<a id="opIdget_embed_preset_videos_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/presets/12345/videos \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/presets/{preset_id}/videos`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-have-been-added-to-an-embed-preset-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|preset_id|path|number|true|The ID of the preset.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-have-been-added-to-an-embed-preset-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-have-been-added-to-an-embed-preset-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get all the videos that have been added to an embed preset

<a id="opIdget_embed_preset_videos"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/presets/12345/videos \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/presets/{preset_id}/videos`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-have-been-added-to-an-embed-preset-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|preset_id|path|number|true|The ID of the preset.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|

## Check if an embed preset has been added to a video

<a id="opIdget_video_embed_preset"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/presets/12345 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /videos/{video_id}/presets/{preset_id}`

<h3 id="check-if-an-embed-preset-has-been-added-to-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|preset_id|path|number|true|The ID of the preset.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="check-if-an-embed-preset-has-been-added-to-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The embed presets exists.|None|
|404|Not Found|No such video or embed preset exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Add an embed preset to a video

<a id="opIdadd_video_embed_preset"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/presets/12345 \
  -X PUT \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /videos/{video_id}/presets/{preset_id}`

<h3 id="add-an-embed-preset-to-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|preset_id|path|number|true|The ID of the preset.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

<h3 id="add-an-embed-preset-to-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The embed preset was assigned.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

## Remove an embed preset from a video

<a id="opIddelete_video_embed_preset"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/presets/12345 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /videos/{video_id}/presets/{preset_id}`

<h3 id="remove-an-embed-preset-from-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|preset_id|path|number|true|The ID of the preset.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

```json
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

|---|---|---|---|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )

## Get all groups

<a id="opIdget_groups"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/groups \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.group+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /groups`

<h3 id="get-all-groups-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `relevant` - Relevant sorting is available only for search queries.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|filter|featured|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|date|
|sort|followers|
|sort|relevant|
|sort|videos|

## Create a group

<a id="opIdcreate_group"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/groups \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.group+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.group+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "Want to participate in our weekly Challenges? Join the Group to receive messages and new Challenges!",
    "name": "Vimeo Weekend Challenge"
  }'
```

`POST /groups`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "Want to participate in our weekly Challenges? Join the Group to receive messages and new Challenges!",
  "name": "Vimeo Weekend Challenge"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» description|body|string|false|The description of the new group.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the new group.|

## Delete a group

<a id="opIddelete_group"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/groups/1108 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /groups/{group_id}`

<h3 id="delete-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|group_id|path|number|true|The ID of the group.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="delete-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The group was deleted.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user isn't the group owner.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: delete )
</aside>

<h1 id="vimeo-groupssubscription">Groups\Subscription</h1>

## Add a user to a group

<a id="opIdjoin_group_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/groups/1108 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /me/groups/{group_id}`

<h3 id="add-a-user-to-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|group_id|path|number|true|The ID of the group.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-user-to-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The user joined the group.|None|
|403|Forbidden|* The authenticated user can't join groups.<br>* The group prohibits the authenticated user from joining, either because the group is not public or because the group's privacy setting is `members`.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: interact )
</aside>

## Remove a user from a group

<a id="opIdleave_group_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/groups/1108 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /me/groups/{group_id}`

<h3 id="remove-a-user-from-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|group_id|path|number|true|The ID of the group.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="remove-a-user-from-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The user left the group.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user owns the group. To remove this user, first apply a new group owner through PATCH.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: interact )
</aside>

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|
|304|Not Modified|No videos have been added to this group since the given `If-Modified-Since` header.|None|
|404|Not Found|No such group exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-group-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get a specific video in a group

<a id="opIdget_group_video"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/groups/1108/videos/258684937 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /groups/{group_id}/videos/{video_id}`

Check if a group has a video.

<h3 id="get-a-specific-video-in-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|group_id|path|number|true|The ID of the group.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|


<h3 id="get-a-specific-video-in-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The video was returned.|[video](#schemavideo)|
|404|Not Found|No such video or group exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Add a video to a group

<a id="opIdadd_video_to_group"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/groups/1108/videos/258684937 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /groups/{group_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="add-a-video-to-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|group_id|path|number|true|The ID of the group.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-video-to-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The video was added.|[video](#schemavideo)|
|202|Accepted|The video is in pending status.|None|
|403|Forbidden|* The video is already in the group.<br>* The user can't add videos to the group.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

## Remove a video from a group

<a id="opIddelete_video_from_group"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/groups/1108/videos/258684937 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /groups/{group_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="remove-a-video-from-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|group_id|path|number|true|The ID of the group.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="remove-a-video-from-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was deleted.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user can't modify this group's videos.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

<h1 id="vimeo-likesessentials">Likes\Essentials</h1>

## Get all the users who have liked a video

<a id="opIdget_video_likes_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/videos/258684937/likes \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.user+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /channels/{channel_id}/videos/{video_id}/likes`

<h3 id="get-all-the-users-who-have-liked-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|date|

<h3 id="get-all-the-users-who-have-liked-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The users were returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-all-the-users-who-have-liked-a-video-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[user](#schemauser)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get all the videos that a user has liked

<a id="opIdget_likes_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/likes \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/likes`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-a-user-has-liked-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|filter_embeddable|query|boolean|false|Whether to filter the results by embeddable videos (`true`) or non-embeddable videos (`false`). Required only if **filter** is `embeddable`.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|filter|embeddable|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|comments|
|sort|date|
|sort|duration|
|sort|likes|
|sort|plays|

## Check if a user has liked a video

<a id="opIdcheck_if_user_liked_video_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/likes/258684937 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/likes/{video_id}`

<h3 id="check-if-a-user-has-liked-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="check-if-a-user-has-liked-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The user has liked the video.|None|
|404|Not Found|The user hasn't liked the video.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Cause a user to like a video

<a id="opIdlike_video_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/likes/258684937 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /me/likes/{video_id}`

<h3 id="cause-a-user-to-like-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="cause-a-user-to-like-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was liked.|None|
|400|Bad Request|The authenticated user owns the video.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user can't like videos.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: interact )
</aside>

## Get all the users who have liked a video on an On Demand page

> Code samples

```bash

  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.user+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ondemand/pages/{ondemand_id}/likes`

This method gets all the users who have liked a particular video on an On Demand page.

<h3 id="get-all-the-users-who-have-liked-a-video-on-an-on-demand-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-a-user-has-liked-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-a-user-has-liked-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Check if a user has liked a video

<a id="opIdcheck_if_user_liked_video"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/likes/258684937 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/likes/{video_id}`

<h3 id="check-if-a-user-has-liked-a-video-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="check-if-a-user-has-liked-a-video-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The user has liked the video.|None|
|404|Not Found|The user hasn't liked the video.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Cause a user to like a video

<a id="opIdlike_video"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/likes/258684937 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /users/{user_id}/likes/{video_id}`

<h3 id="cause-a-user-to-like-a-video-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="cause-a-user-to-like-a-video-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was liked.|None|
|400|Bad Request|The authenticated user owns the video.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user can't like videos.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: interact )
</aside>

## Cause a user to unlike a video

<a id="opIdunlike_video"></a>

> Code samples


<h3 id="get-all-the-on-demand-pages-of-a-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The On Demand pages were returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|No such user exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<h3 id="get-all-the-on-demand-pages-of-a-user-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[on-demand-page](#schemaon-demand-page)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Create an On Demand page

<a id="opIdcreate_vod_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/ondemand/pages \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "accepted_currencies": "AUD",
    "buy": {
      "active": "true",
      "download": "true",
      "price": {
        "AUD": 2.99,
        "CAD": 2.99,
        "CHF": 2.99,
        "DKK": 2.99,
        "EUR": 2.99,
        "GBP": 2.99,
        "JPY": 2.99,
        "KRW": 2.99,
        "NOK": 2.99,
        "PLN": 2.99,
        "SEK": 2.99,
        "USD": 2.99
      }
    },
    "content_rating": "drugs",
    "description": "DARBY FOREVER follows the fantasies of Darby, a shopgirl at \"Bobbins & Notions\".",
    "domain_link": "https://example.com",
    "episodes": {
      "buy": {
        "active": "true",
        "download": "true",
        "price": {
          "USD": 1.99
        }
      },
      "rent": {
        "active": "true",
        "period": "1 week",
        "price": {
          "USD": 0.99
        }
      }
    },
    "link": "darbyforever",
    "name": "Darby Forever",
    "rent": {
      "active": "true",
      "period": "1 week",
      "price": {
        "AUD": 0.99,
        "CAD": 0.99,
        "CHF": 0.99,
        "DKK": 0.99,
        "EUR": 0.99,
        "GBP": 0.99,
        "JPY": 0.99,
        "KRW": 0.99,
        "NOK": 0.99,
        "PLN": 0.99,
        "SEK": 0.99,
        "USD": 0.99
      }
    },
    "subscription": {
      "monthly": {
        "active": "true",
        "price": {
          "USD": 9.99
        }
      }
    },
    "type": "film"
  }'
```
