<h3 id="create-an-on-demand-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» accepted_currencies|body|string|false|An array of accepted currencies.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `AUD` - Australian Dollar<br> * `CAD` - Canadian Dollar<br> * `CHF` - Swiss Franc<br> * `DKK` - Danish Krone<br> * `EUR` - Euro<br> * `GBP` - British Pound<br> * `JPY` - Japanese Yen<br> * `KRW` - South Korean Won<br> * `NOK` - Norwegian Krone<br> * `PLN` - Polish Zloty<br> * `SEK` - Swedish Krona<br> * `USD` - US Dollar<br>|
|» buy|body|object|false|none|
|» » active|body|boolean|false|Whether the Buy action is active. *Required if `rent.active` is false.|
|» » download|body|boolean|false|Whether people who buy the video can download it. To use this field, `type` must be `film`.|
|» » price|body|object|false|none|
|» » » AUD|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in AUD.|
|» » » CAD|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in CAD.|
|» » » CHF|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in CHF.|
|» » » DKK|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in DKK.|
|» » » EUR|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in EUR.|
|» » » GBP|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in GBP.|
|» » » JPY|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in JPY.|
|» » » KRW|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in KRW.|
|» » » NOK|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in NOK.|
|» » » PLN|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in PLN.|
|» » » SEK|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in SEK.|
|» » » USD|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in USD when `type` is `film`, or the purchase price of the entire collection in USD when `type` is `series`.|
|» content_rating|body|string|true|One or more ratings, either as a comma-separated list or as a JSON array depending on the request format.|
|» description|body|string|true|The description of the On Demand page.|
|» domain_link|body|string|false|The custom domain of the On Demand page.|
|» episodes|body|object|false|none|
|» » buy|body|object|false|none|
|» » » active|body|boolean|false|Whether episodes can be bought.|
|» » » download|body|boolean|false|Whether people who buy the episode can download it. To use this field, `type` must be `series`.|
|» » » price|body|object|false|none|
|» » » » USD|body|number|false|The purchase price per episode. *Required if `episodes.buy.active` is true.|
|» » rent|body|object|false|none|
|» » » active|body|boolean|false|Whether episodes can be rented|
|» » » period|body|string|false|The period in which this episode can be rented for.|
|» » » price|body|object|false|none|
|» » » » USD|body|number|false|The default price to rent an episode. This field is applicable only when `type` is `series`. *Required if `episodes.rent.active` is true.|
|» link|body|string|false|The custom string to use in this On Demand page's Vimeo URL.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the On Demand page.|
|» rent|body|object|false|none|
|» » active|body|boolean|false|Whether the video can be rented. *Required if `buy.active` is false.|
|» » period|body|string|false|The period in which this can be rented for.|
|» » price|body|object|false|none|
|» » » AUD|body|number|false|The rental price of this video in AUD.|
|» » » CAD|body|number|false|The rental price of this video in CAD.|
|» » » CHF|body|number|false|The rental price of this video in CHF.|
|» » » DKK|body|number|false|The rental price of this video in DKK.|

|» » » USD|body|number|false|The rental price of this video in USD when `type` is `film`, or the rental price of the entire collection in USD when `type` is `series`.|
|» subscription|body|object|false|none|

<h3 id="create-an-on-demand-page-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|The On Demand page was created.|[on-demand-page](#schemaon-demand-page)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get a specific On Demand page

<a id="opIdget_vod"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/pages/61326 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.page+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ondemand/pages/{ondemand_id}`

<h3 id="get-a-specific-on-demand-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ondemand_id|path|number|true|The ID of the On Demand.|

<h3 id="get-a-specific-on-demand-page-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The On Demand page was returned.|[on-demand-page](#schemaon-demand-page)|
|404|Not Found|No such On Demand page exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Delete a draft of an On Demand page

<a id="opIddelete_vod_draft"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/pages/61326 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.page+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /ondemand/pages/{ondemand_id}`

<h3 id="delete-a-draft-of-an-on-demand-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ondemand_id|path|number|true|The ID of the On Demand.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="delete-a-draft-of-an-on-demand-page-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The page draft was deleted.|None|
|403|Forbidden|You can't modify an On Demand page that you don't own.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such On Demand page exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: delete )
</aside>

## Edit an On Demand page

<a id="opIdedit_vod"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/pages/61326 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.page+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.page+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "link": "darbyforever",
    "preorder": {
      "active": "true",
      "publish_time": "2017-05-16T15:05:43+00:00"
    },
    "publish": {
      "active": "true"
    },
    "publish_when_ready": "true"
  }'
```

`PATCH /ondemand/pages/{ondemand_id}`

Enable preorders or publish the page.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "link": "darbyforever",
  "preorder": {
    "active": "true",
    "publish_time": "2017-05-16T15:05:43+00:00"
  },
  "publish": {
    "active": "true"
  },
  "publish_when_ready": "true"
}
```

<h3 id="edit-an-on-demand-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ondemand_id|path|number|true|The ID of the On Demand.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» link|body|string|false|The custom string to use in this On Demand page's Vimeo URL.|
|» preorder|body|object|false|none|
|» » active|body|boolean|false|If set to true, you will enable pre-orders on the On Demand page.|
|» » publish_time|body|string|false|The time that the On Demand page will be published. *Required if `preorder.active` is `true`.|
|» publish|body|object|false|none|
|» » active|body|boolean|false|Whether to publish the On Demand page.|
|» publish_when_ready|body|boolean|false|Whether to publish the On Demand page automatically after all videos are finished transcoding.|

<h3 id="edit-an-on-demand-page-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The On Demand page was edited.|[on-demand-page](#schemaon-demand-page)|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user can't edit the On Demand page.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such On Demand page exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

## Get all the On Demand pages of a user

<a id="opIdget_user_vods"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/ondemand/pages \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.page+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/ondemand/pages`

<h3 id="get-all-the-on-demand-pages-of-a-user-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|filter|query|string|false|The type of On Demand pages to return.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|filter|film|
|filter|series|
|sort|added|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|date|
|sort|modified_time|
|sort|name|
|sort|publish.time|
|sort|rating|

<h3 id="get-all-the-on-demand-pages-of-a-user-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The On Demand pages were returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|No such user exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<h3 id="get-all-the-on-demand-pages-of-a-user-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[on-demand-page](#schemaon-demand-page)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Create an On Demand page

<a id="opIdcreate_vod"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/ondemand/pages \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "accepted_currencies": "AUD",
    "buy": {
      "active": "true",
      "download": "true",
      "price": {
        "AUD": 2.99,
        "CAD": 2.99,
        "CHF": 2.99,
        "DKK": 2.99,
        "EUR": 2.99,
        "GBP": 2.99,
        "JPY": 2.99,
        "KRW": 2.99,
        "NOK": 2.99,
        "PLN": 2.99,
        "SEK": 2.99,
        "USD": 2.99
      }
    },
    "content_rating": "drugs",
    "description": "DARBY FOREVER follows the fantasies of Darby, a shopgirl at \"Bobbins & Notions\".",
    "domain_link": "https://example.com",
    "episodes": {
      "buy": {
        "active": "true",
        "download": "true",
        "price": {
          "USD": 1.99
        }
      },
      "rent": {
        "active": "true",
        "period": "1 week",
        "price": {
          "USD": 0.99
        }
      }
    },
    "link": "darbyforever",
    "name": "Darby Forever",
    "rent": {
      "active": "true",
      "period": "1 week",
      "price": {
        "AUD": 0.99,
        "CAD": 0.99,
        "CHF": 0.99,
        "DKK": 0.99,
        "EUR": 0.99,
        "GBP": 0.99,
        "JPY": 0.99,
        "KRW": 0.99,
        "NOK": 0.99,
        "PLN": 0.99,
        "SEK": 0.99,
        "USD": 0.99
      }
    },
    "subscription": {
      "monthly": {
        "active": "true",
        "price": {
          "USD": 9.99
        }
      }
    },
    "type": "film"
  }'
```

<h3 id="create-an-on-demand-page-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» accepted_currencies|body|string|false|An array of accepted currencies.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `AUD` - Australian Dollar<br> * `CAD` - Canadian Dollar<br> * `CHF` - Swiss Franc<br> * `DKK` - Danish Krone<br> * `EUR` - Euro<br> * `GBP` - British Pound<br> * `JPY` - Japanese Yen<br> * `KRW` - South Korean Won<br> * `NOK` - Norwegian Krone<br> * `PLN` - Polish Zloty<br> * `SEK` - Swedish Krona<br> * `USD` - US Dollar<br>|
|» buy|body|object|false|none|
|» » active|body|boolean|false|Whether the Buy action is active. *Required if `rent.active` is false.|
|» » download|body|boolean|false|Whether people who buy the video can download it. To use this field, `type` must be `film`.|
|» » price|body|object|false|none|
|» » » AUD|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in AUD.|
|» » » CAD|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in CAD.|
|» » » CHF|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in CHF.|
|» » » DKK|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in DKK.|
|» » » EUR|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in EUR.|
|» » » GBP|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in GBP.|
|» » » JPY|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in JPY.|
|» » » KRW|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in KRW.|
|» » » NOK|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in NOK.|
|» » » PLN|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in PLN.|
|» » » SEK|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in SEK.|
|» » » USD|body|number|false|The purchase price of this video in USD when `type` is `film`, or the purchase price of the entire collection in USD when `type` is `series`.|
|» content_rating|body|string|true|One or more ratings, either as a comma-separated list or as a JSON array depending on the request format.|
|» description|body|string|true|The description of the On Demand page.|
|» domain_link|body|string|false|The custom domain of the On Demand page.|
|» episodes|body|object|false|none|
|» » buy|body|object|false|none|
|» » » active|body|boolean|false|Whether episodes can be bought.|
|» » » download|body|boolean|false|Whether people who buy the episode can download it. To use this field, `type` must be `series`.|
|» » » price|body|object|false|none|
|» » » » USD|body|number|false|The purchase price per episode. *Required if `episodes.buy.active` is true.|
|» » rent|body|object|false|none|
|» » » active|body|boolean|false|Whether episodes can be rented|
|» » » period|body|string|false|The period in which this episode can be rented for.|
|» » » price|body|object|false|none|
|» » » » USD|body|number|false|The default price to rent an episode. This field is applicable only when `type` is `series`. *Required if `episodes.rent.active` is true.|
|» link|body|string|false|The custom string to use in this On Demand page's Vimeo URL.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the On Demand page.|
|» rent|body|object|false|none|
|» » active|body|boolean|false|Whether the video can be rented. *Required if `buy.active` is false.|
|» » period|body|string|false|The period in which this can be rented for.|
|» » price|body|object|false|none|
|» » » AUD|body|number|false|The rental price of this video in AUD.|
|» » » CAD|body|number|false|The rental price of this video in CAD.|
|» » » CHF|body|number|false|The rental price of this video in CHF.|
|» » » DKK|body|number|false|The rental price of this video in DKK.|
|» » » EUR|body|number|false|The rental price of this video in EUR.|

|» » » PLN|body|number|false|The rental price of this video in PLN.|
|» » » SEK|body|number|false|The rental price of this video in SEK.|
|» » » USD|body|number|false|The rental price of this video in USD when `type` is `film`, or the rental price of the entire collection in USD when `type` is `series`.|
|» subscription|body|object|false|none|
|» » monthly|body|object|false|none|
|» » » active|body|boolean|false|Whether monthly subscription is active. *Required if `rent.active` and `buy.active` are false.|
|» » » price|body|object|false|none|
|» » » » USD|body|number|false|The monthly subscription price in USD. *Required if `subscription.active` is true.|
|» type|body|string|true|The type of On Demand page.|

<h1 id="vimeo-on-demandgenres">On Demand\Genres</h1>

## Get all On Demand genres

<a id="opIdget_vod_genres"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/genres \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.genre+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ondemand/genres`

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "canonical": "horror",
    "interactions": {
      "page": {
        "added": "true",
        "options": [
          "string"
        ],
        "uri": "/ondemand/genres/horror/pages/12345"
      }
    },
    "link": "http://vimeo.com/ondemand/browse/horror",
    "metadata": {
      "connections": {
        "pages": {
          "options": [
            "string"
          ],
          "uri": "/ondemand/genres/horror/pages"
        }
      }
    },
    "name": "Horror",
    "uri": "/ondemand/genres/horror"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="get-all-on-demand-genres-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The On Demand genres were returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-all-on-demand-genres-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[on-demand-genre](#schemaon-demand-genre)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get a specific On Demand genre

<a id="opIdget_vod_genre"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/genres/animation \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.genre+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ondemand/genres/{genre_id}`

<h3 id="get-a-specific-on-demand-genre-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|genre_id|path|string|true|The ID of the genre.|

```json
{
  "canonical": "horror",
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The On Demand genre was returned.|[on-demand-genre](#schemaon-demand-genre)|
|404|Not Found|No such On Demand genre exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get all the On Demand pages in a genre

<a id="opIdget_genre_vods"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/genres/animation/pages \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.page+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ondemand/genres/{genre_id}/pages`

<h3 id="get-all-the-on-demand-pages-in-a-genre-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|genre_id|path|string|true|The ID of the genre.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|filter|country|
|filter|my_region|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|date|
|sort|name|
|sort|publish.time|
|sort|videos|

<h3 id="get-all-the-on-demand-pages-in-a-genre-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The On Demand pages were returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-all-the-on-demand-pages-in-a-genre-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[on-demand-page](#schemaon-demand-page)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get a specific On Demand page in a genre

<a id="opIdget_genre_vod"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/genres/animation/pages/61326 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.page+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ondemand/genres/{genre_id}/pages/{ondemand_id}`

Check whether a genre contains an On Demand page.

<h3 id="get-a-specific-on-demand-page-in-a-genre-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|genre_id|path|string|true|The ID of the genre.|
|ondemand_id|path|number|true|The ID of the On Demand.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response


## Get all the genres of an On Demand page

<a id="opIdget_vod_genres_by_ondemand_id"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/pages/61326/genres \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.genre+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ondemand/pages/{ondemand_id}/genres`

<h3 id="get-all-the-genres-of-an-on-demand-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ondemand_id|path|number|true|The ID of the On Demand.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "canonical": "horror",
    "interactions": {
      "page": {
        "added": "true",
        "options": [
          "string"
        ],
        "uri": "/ondemand/genres/horror/pages/12345"
      }
    },
    "link": "http://vimeo.com/ondemand/browse/horror",
    "metadata": {
      "connections": {
        "pages": {
          "options": [
            "string"
          ],
          "uri": "/ondemand/genres/horror/pages"
        }
      }
    },
    "name": "Horror",
    "uri": "/ondemand/genres/horror"
  }
]
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The genres were returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|No such On Demand page exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|


`PUT /ondemand/pages/{ondemand_id}/genres/{genre_id}`

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|ondemand_id|path|number|true|The ID of the On Demand.|

```json
      "options": [
        "string"
      ],
      "uri": "/ondemand/genres/horror/pages/12345"

    "connections": {
```

```json
{
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-genre-to-an-on-demand-page-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|The genre was added.|[on-demand-genre](#schemaon-demand-genre)|
|400|Bad Request|You can't add more than two genres to an On Demand page.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|403|Forbidden|You can't modify an On Demand page that you don't own.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such On Demand page or genre exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

</aside>

## Add a promotion to an On Demand page

<a id="opIdcreate_vod_promotion"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/pages/61326/promotions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.promotion+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.promotion+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "access_type": "default",
    "code": "sxsw2018",
    "discount_type": "free",
    "download": "true",
    "end_time": "1526089920",
    "label": "sxsw",
    "percent_off": 50,
    "product_type": "any",
    "start_time": "1526089920",
    "stream_period": "1_week",
    "total": 9,
    "type": "batch"
  }'
```

`POST /ondemand/pages/{ondemand_id}/promotions`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "access_type": "default",
  "code": "sxsw2018",
  "discount_type": "free",
  "download": "true",
  "end_time": "1526089920",
  "label": "sxsw",
  "percent_off": 50,
  "product_type": "any",
  "start_time": "1526089920",
  "stream_period": "1_week",
  "total": 9,
  "type": "batch"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-promotion-to-an-on-demand-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ondemand_id|path|number|true|The ID of the On Demand.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» access_type|body|string|false|The promotion access type, which is a purchase option that isn't available on the container. VIP promotions always make the content free of charge. If you use this type, you must further define the promotion with the `download` or `stream_period` fields.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `default` - Promotions grant discount on the existing purchase options for an On Demand Container.<br> * `vip` - Promotions can be used to grant free access to VOD content before it is released, or to offer a purchase option that isn't available on the container. "vip" promotions will always make the content free, and must be further defined with the `download` or `stream_period` fields.<br>|
|» code|body|string|false|The promotion code. This field is ignored for batch promotions.|
|» discount_type|body|string|false|The type of discount offered by the promo code. When `access_type` is `vip`, the value of this field must be `free`.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `free` - Reduces the price to zero.<br> * `percent` - Reduces the price by an amount defined in the "percent_off" field.<br>|
|» download|body|boolean|true|Whether the promotion grants download access to VOD content. This is necessary only when not previously defined in the On Demand container or when `access_type` is `vip` or `product_type` is `buy`.|
|» end_time|body|string|false|The end of the promotion period. If you don't specify a value, the promotion will never expire.|
|» label|body|string|false|The description of a batch promotion. This field is ignored for single promotions.|
|» percent_off|body|number|false|The percentage of the discount by using this promo code. This field is applicable only when `discount_type` is `percent`.|
|» product_type|body|string|false|The type of transaction to which the promotion applies. When `access_type` is `default`, the default value is `any`, but the default value is `rent` when `access_type` is `vip`. Also, when `access_type` is `vip`, the only valid product types are `buy` and `rent`.|
|» start_time|body|string|false|The start of the promotion period. If you don't specify a value, the start time defaults to the time that the promotion was created.|
|» stream_period|body|string|true|The amount of time that a user has access to the VOD content upon redeeming a promo code. This field is necessary only when not defined in the On Demand container or when creating promotions when `access_type` is `vip` or `product_type` is `rent`.|
|» total|body|number|true|The number of promotions to generate when `type` is `batch`, or the number of uses of the promotion when `type` is `single`.|
|» type|body|string|true|The type of promotion. When `access_type` is `vip`, the value for this field must be `batch`.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `batch` - Generates many random promo codes with one use each.<br> * `single` - Generates one promo code that can be used many times.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» access_type|default|
|» access_type|vip|
|» discount_type|free|
|» discount_type|percent|
|» product_type|any|
|» product_type|buy|
|» product_type|buy_episode|
|» product_type|rent|
|» product_type|rent_episode|
|» product_type|subscribe|
|» stream_period|1_week|
|» stream_period|1_year|
|» stream_period|24_hour|
|» stream_period|30_day|
|» stream_period|3_month|
|» stream_period|48_hour|
|» stream_period|6_month|
|» stream_period|72_hour|
|» type|batch|
|» type|single|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "access_type": "default",
  "discount_type": "free",
  "download": "true",
  "label": "8jgaieumbzstujhn8k304iwwezawkvwm",
  "metadata": {
    "connections": {
      "codes": {
        "options": [
          "string"
        ],
```

```json
}
```

<h3 id="get-all-the-on-demand-purchases-and-rentals-that-a-user-has-made-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The purchases and rentals were returned.|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user can't view the purchases and rentals for another user's account.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<h3 id="get-all-the-on-demand-purchases-and-rentals-that-a-user-has-made-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[on-demand-page](#schemaon-demand-page)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: purchased )
</aside>

## Check if a user has made a purchase or rental from an On Demand page

<a id="opIdcheck_if_vod_was_purchased_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/ondemand/purchases/61326 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.page+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/ondemand/purchases/{ondemand_id}`

<h3 id="check-if-a-user-has-made-a-purchase-or-rental-from-an-on-demand-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ondemand_id|path|number|true|The ID of the On Demand.|

<h3 id="check-if-a-user-has-made-a-purchase-or-rental-from-an-on-demand-page-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|You have purchased the On Demand page.|[on-demand-page](#schemaon-demand-page)|
|403|Forbidden|The requested user isn't the same as the authenticated user.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such user or On Demand page exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: purchased )
</aside>

## Check if a user has made a purchase or rental from an On Demand page

<a id="opIdcheck_if_vod_was_purchased"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/ondemand/purchases \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.page+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/ondemand/purchases`

<h3 id="check-if-a-user-has-made-a-purchase-or-rental-from-an-on-demand-page-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|

<h1 id="vimeo-on-demandregions">On Demand\Regions</h1>

## Get all the regions of an On Demand page

<a id="opIdget_vod_regions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/pages/61326/regions \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.region+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ondemand/pages/{ondemand_id}/regions`

<h3 id="get-all-the-regions-of-an-on-demand-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ondemand_id|path|number|true|The ID of the On Demand.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "country_code": "US",
    "country_name": "United States",
    "uri": "/ondemand/pages/61326/regions/US"
  }
]
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="get-all-the-regions-of-an-on-demand-page-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The regions were returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|No such On Demand page exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<h3 id="get-all-the-regions-of-an-on-demand-page-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[on-demand-region](#schemaon-demand-region)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Add a list of regions to an On Demand page

<a id="opIdset_vod_regions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/pages/61326/regions \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.region+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.region+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "countries": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /ondemand/pages/{ondemand_id}/regions`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "countries": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-list-of-regions-to-an-on-demand-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ondemand_id|path|number|true|The ID of the On Demand.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» countries|body|[string]|true|An array of country codes.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "country_code": "US",
  "country_name": "United States",
  "uri": "/ondemand/pages/61326/regions/US"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-list-of-regions-to-an-on-demand-page-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The list of regions was set.|[on-demand-region](#schemaon-demand-region)|
|403|Forbidden|You can't modify an On Demand page that you don't own.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such On Demand page or region exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-season-on-an-on-demand-page-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-season-on-an-on-demand-page-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

<h1 id="vimeo-on-demandvideos">On Demand\Videos</h1>

## Get all the videos on an On Demand page

<a id="opIdget_vod_videos"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/pages/61326/videos \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ondemand/pages/{ondemand_id}/videos`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-on-an-on-demand-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ondemand_id|path|number|true|The ID of the On Demand.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-on-an-on-demand-page-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get a specific video on an On Demand page

<a id="opIdget_vod_video"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/pages/61326/videos/12345 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /ondemand/pages/{ondemand_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="get-a-specific-video-on-an-on-demand-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ondemand_id|path|number|true|The ID of the On Demand.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

## Add a video to an On Demand page

<a id="opIdadd_video_to_vod"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/pages/61326/videos/12345 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.video+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "buy": {
      "price": {
        "AUD": 1.99,
        "CAD": 1.99,
        "CHF": 1.99,
        "DKK": 1.99,
        "EUR": 1.99,
        "GBP": 1.99,
        "JPY": 1.99,
        "KRW": 1.99,
        "NOK": 1.99,
        "PLN": 1.99,
        "SEK": 1.99,
        "USD": 1.99
      }
    },
    "position": 10,
    "release_year": 2018,
    "rent": {
      "price": {
        "AUD": 0.99,
        "CAD": 0.99,
        "CHF": 0.99,
        "DKK": 0.99,
        "EUR": 0.99,
        "GBP": 0.99,
        "JPY": 0.99,
        "KRW": 0.99,
        "NOK": 0.99,
        "PLN": 0.99,
        "SEK": 0.99,
        "USD": 0.99
      }
    },
    "type": "extra"
  }'
```

## Remove a video from an On Demand page

<a id="opIddelete_video_from_vod"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/ondemand/pages/61326/videos/12345 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.ondemand.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /ondemand/pages/{ondemand_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="remove-a-video-from-an-on-demand-page-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ondemand_id|path|number|true|The ID of the On Demand.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )

## Get all the portfolios that belong to a user

<a id="opIdget_portfolios_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/portfolios \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.portfolio+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/portfolios`

<h3 id="get-all-the-portfolios-that-belong-to-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|date|

<h3 id="get-all-the-portfolios-that-belong-to-a-user-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The portfolios were returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-all-the-portfolios-that-belong-to-a-user-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[portfolio](#schemaportfolio)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get a specific portfolio

<a id="opIdget_portfolio"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/portfolios/12345 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.portfolio+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/portfolios/{portfolio_id}`

<h3 id="get-a-specific-portfolio-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|portfolio_id|path|number|true|The ID of the portfolio.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|

> 200 Response

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

</aside>

<h1 id="vimeo-portfoliosvideos">Portfolios\Videos</h1>

## Get all the videos in a portfolio

<a id="opIdget_portfolio_videos_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/portfolios/12345/videos \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/portfolios/{portfolio_id}/videos`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-portfolio-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|portfolio_id|path|number|true|The ID of the portfolio.|
|containing_uri|query|string|false|The page that contains the video URI.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|filter_embeddable|query|boolean|false|Whether to filter the results by embeddable videos (`true`) or non-embeddable videos (`false`). Required only if **filter** is `embeddable`.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `default` - This will sort to the default sort set on the portfolio.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|filter|embeddable|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|comments|
|sort|date|
|sort|default|
|sort|likes|
|sort|manual|
|sort|plays|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-portfolio-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get a specific video in a portfolio

<a id="opIdget_portfolio_video_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/portfolios/12345/videos/258684937 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/portfolios/{portfolio_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="get-a-specific-video-in-a-portfolio-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|portfolio_id|path|number|true|The ID of the portfolio.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The video was returned.|[video](#schemavideo)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Add a video to a portfolio

<a id="opIdadd_video_to_portfolio_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/portfolios/12345/videos/258684937 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /me/portfolios/{portfolio_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="add-a-video-to-a-portfolio-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|portfolio_id|path|number|true|The ID of the portfolio.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-video-to-a-portfolio-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was added.|None|
|404|Not Found|The portfolio wasn't found, or the video wasn't found.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

## Remove a video from a portfolio

<a id="opIddelete_video_from_portfolio_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/portfolios/12345/videos/258684937 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /me/portfolios/{portfolio_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="remove-a-video-from-a-portfolio-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|portfolio_id|path|number|true|The ID of the portfolio.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="remove-a-video-from-a-portfolio-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was deleted.|None|
|404|Not Found|The portfolio wasn't found, or the video wasn't found.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

## Get all the videos in a portfolio

<a id="opIdget_portfolio_videos"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/portfolios/12345/videos \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/portfolios/{portfolio_id}/videos`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-portfolio-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|portfolio_id|path|number|true|The ID of the portfolio.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|containing_uri|query|string|false|The page that contains the video URI.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|filter_embeddable|query|boolean|false|Whether to filter the results by embeddable videos (`true`) or non-embeddable videos (`false`). Required only if **filter** is `embeddable`.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `default` - This will sort to the default sort set on the portfolio.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|filter|embeddable|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|comments|
|sort|date|
|sort|default|
|sort|likes|
|sort|manual|
|sort|plays|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-portfolio-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-portfolio-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get a specific video in a portfolio

<a id="opIdget_portfolio_video"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/portfolios/12345/videos/258684937 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/portfolios/{portfolio_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="get-a-specific-video-in-a-portfolio-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|portfolio_id|path|number|true|The ID of the portfolio.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

## Add a video to a portfolio

<a id="opIdadd_video_to_portfolio"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/portfolios/12345/videos/258684937 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /users/{user_id}/portfolios/{portfolio_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="add-a-video-to-a-portfolio-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|portfolio_id|path|number|true|The ID of the portfolio.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-video-to-a-portfolio-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was added.|None|
|404|Not Found|The portfolio wasn't found, or the video wasn't found.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

<a id="opIddelete_video_from_portfolio"></a>

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/portfolios/12345/videos/258684937 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /users/{user_id}/portfolios/{portfolio_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="remove-a-video-from-a-portfolio-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|portfolio_id|path|number|true|The ID of the portfolio.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="remove-a-video-from-a-portfolio-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was deleted.|None|
|404|Not Found|The portfolio wasn't found, or the video wasn't found.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )

## Get all the projects that belong to a user

<a id="opIdget_projects_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/projects \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/projects`

This method gets all the projects that belong to the specified user.

<h3 id="get-all-the-projects-that-belong-to-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort|date|
|sort|default|
|sort|modified_time|
|sort|name|

## Create a project

<a id="opIdcreate_project_alt1"></a>

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/projects \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Rough cuts"
  }'
```

## Get a specific project

<a id="opIdget_project_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/projects/12345 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

## Delete a project

<a id="opIddelete_project_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/projects/12345 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /me/projects/{project_id}`

This method deletes a project and optionally also the videos that it contains.

<h3 id="delete-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|project_id|path|number|true|The ID of the project.|
|should_delete_clips|query|boolean|false|Whether to delete all the videos in the project along with the project itself.|

> Example responses

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="delete-a-project-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The project was deleted.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Error code 8000: The user credentials are invalid.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|403|Forbidden|Error code 3200: The authenticated user can't delete the project.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|404|Not Found|Error code 5000: No such project exists.|[error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: delete )
</aside>

## Edit a project

<a id="opIdedit_project_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/projects/12345 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Rough cuts"
  }'
```

`PATCH /me/projects/{project_id}`

This method edits an existing project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "Rough cuts"
}
```

<h3 id="edit-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|project_id|path|number|true|The ID of the project.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the project.|

## Delete a project

<a id="opIddelete_project"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/projects/12345 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /users/{user_id}/projects/{project_id}`

This method deletes a project and optionally also the videos that it contains.

<h3 id="delete-a-project-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|project_id|path|number|true|The ID of the project.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|should_delete_clips|query|boolean|false|Whether to delete all the videos in the project along with the project itself.|

> Example responses

> 401 Response

```json
{

  "link": "string"
}
```

```json

  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"

```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="delete-a-project-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|---|---|---|---|

|401|Unauthorized|Error code 8000: The user credentials are invalid.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|403|Forbidden|Error code 3200: The authenticated user can't delete the project.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|404|Not Found|Error code 5000: No such project exists.|[error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: delete )
</aside>

## Edit a project

<a id="opIdedit_project"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/projects/12345 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Rough cuts"
  }'
```

`PATCH /users/{user_id}/projects/{project_id}`

This method edits an existing project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "Rough cuts"
}
```

<h3 id="edit-a-project-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|project_id|path|number|true|The ID of the project.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the project.|

<h1 id="vimeo-projectsvideos">Projects\Videos</h1>

## Get all the videos in a project

<a id="opIdget_project_videos_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/projects/12345/videos \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/projects/{project_id}/videos`

This method gets all the videos that belong to the specified project.

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|project_id|path|number|true|The ID of the project.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|date|
|sort|default|
|sort|duration|
|sort|last_user_action_event_date|

## Get all the videos in a project

<a id="opIdget_project_videos"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/projects/12345/videos \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/projects/{project_id}/videos`

This method gets all the videos that belong to the specified project.

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-project-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|project_id|path|number|true|The ID of the project.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort|alphabetical|

## Edit a user

<a id="opIdedit_user_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.user+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.user+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "bio": "This is where you will find videos and news updates from the staff",
    "content_filter": [
      "string"
    ],
    "link": "staff",
    "location": "New York City",
    "name": "Vimeo Staff",
    "password": "hunter1",
    "videos": {
      "privacy": {
        "add": "true",
        "comments": "anybody",
        "download": "true",
        "embed": "private",
        "view": "anybody"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /me`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "bio": "This is where you will find videos and news updates from the staff",
  "content_filter": [
    "string"
  ],
  "link": "staff",
  "location": "New York City",
  "name": "Vimeo Staff",
  "password": "hunter1",
  "videos": {
    "privacy": {
      "add": "true",
      "comments": "anybody",
      "download": "true",
      "embed": "private",
      "view": "anybody"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="edit-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» bio|body|string|false|The user's bio.|
|» content_filter|body|[string]|false|A list of values describing the content in this video. Find the full list in the [/contentratings](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/endpoints/videos#GET/contentratings) endpoint. You must provide a comma-separated list if you are using a query string or an array if you are using JSON.|
|» link|body|string|false|The user's custom Vimeo URL slug.|
|» location|body|string|false|The user's location.|
|» name|body|string|false|The user's display name.|
|» password|body|string|false|The default password for all future videos that this user uploads. To use this field, the `videos.privacy.view` field must be `password`.|
|» videos|body|object|false|none|
|» » privacy|body|object|false|none|
|» » » add|body|boolean|false|Whether a user can add the video to an album, channel, or group. This value becomes the default add setting for all future videos uploaded by the user.|
|» » » comments|body|string|false|Who can comment on the video. This value becomes the default comment setting for all future videos that this user uploads.|
|» » » download|body|boolean|false|Whether a user can download the video. This value becomes the default download setting for all future videos that this user uploads.|
|» » » embed|body|string|false|The privacy for embed videos. The `whitelist` value enables you to define all valid embed domains. See our [documentation](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/endpoints/videos#/{video_id}/privacy/domains) for adding and removing domains.|
|» » » view|body|string|false|Who can view the video. This value becomes the default view setting for all future videos that this user uploads.|

|» » » comments|nobody|

|» » » embed|public|

|» » » view|anybody|

|» » » view|nobody|
|» » » view|password|
|» » » view|unlisted|
|» » » view|users|

## Edit a user

<a id="opIdedit_user"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.user+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.user+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "bio": "This is where you will find videos and news updates from the staff",
    "content_filter": [
      "string"
    ],
    "link": "staff",
    "location": "New York City",
    "name": "Vimeo Staff",
    "password": "hunter1",
    "videos": {
      "privacy": {
        "add": "true",
        "comments": "anybody",
        "download": "true",
        "embed": "private",
        "view": "anybody"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /users/{user_id}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "bio": "This is where you will find videos and news updates from the staff",
  "content_filter": [
    "string"
  ],
  "link": "staff",
  "location": "New York City",
  "name": "Vimeo Staff",
  "password": "hunter1",
  "videos": {
    "privacy": {
      "add": "true",
      "comments": "anybody",
      "download": "true",
      "embed": "private",
      "view": "anybody"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="edit-a-user-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» bio|body|string|false|The user's bio.|
|» content_filter|body|[string]|false|A list of values describing the content in this video. Find the full list in the [/contentratings](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/endpoints/videos#GET/contentratings) endpoint. You must provide a comma-separated list if you are using a query string or an array if you are using JSON.|
|» link|body|string|false|The user's custom Vimeo URL slug.|
|» location|body|string|false|The user's location.|
|» name|body|string|false|The user's display name.|
|» password|body|string|false|The default password for all future videos that this user uploads. To use this field, the `videos.privacy.view` field must be `password`.|
|» videos|body|object|false|none|
|» » privacy|body|object|false|none|
|» » » add|body|boolean|false|Whether a user can add the video to an album, channel, or group. This value becomes the default add setting for all future videos uploaded by the user.|
|» » » comments|body|string|false|Who can comment on the video. This value becomes the default comment setting for all future videos that this user uploads.|
|» » » download|body|boolean|false|Whether a user can download the video. This value becomes the default download setting for all future videos that this user uploads.|
|» » » embed|body|string|false|The privacy for embed videos. The `whitelist` value enables you to define all valid embed domains. See our [documentation](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/endpoints/videos#/{video_id}/privacy/domains) for adding and removing domains.|
|» » » view|body|string|false|Who can view the video. This value becomes the default view setting for all future videos that this user uploads.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » » comments|anybody|
|» » » comments|contacts|
|» » » comments|nobody|
|» » » embed|private|
|» » » embed|public|
|» » » embed|whitelist|
|» » » view|anybody|
|» » » view|contacts|
|» » » view|disable|
|» » » view|nobody|
|» » » view|password|
|» » » view|unlisted|
|» » » view|users|

|---|---|---|---|---|

|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|type|query|string|false|The feed type.|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

## Get all videos in a user's feed

<a id="opIdget_feed"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/feed \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.activity+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/feed`

<h3 id="get-all-videos-in-a-users-feed-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|offset|query|string|false|Necessary for proper pagination. You shouldn't provide this value yourself, and instead use the pagination links in the feed response. Please see our [pagination documentation](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/common-formats#using-the-pagination-parameter) for more information.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|type|query|string|false|The feed type.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|appears|
|type|category_featured|
|type|channel|
|type|facebook_feed|
|type|following|
|type|group|
|type|likes|
|type|ondemand_publish|
|type|share|
|type|tagged_with|
|type|twitter_timeline|
|type|uploads|

<h1 id="vimeo-usersfollows">Users\Follows</h1>

## Get all the followers of a user

<a id="opIdget_followers_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/followers \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.user+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/followers`

<h3 id="get-all-the-followers-of-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|date|

## Follow a list of users

<a id="opIdfollow_users_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/following \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "users": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /me/following`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "users": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="follow-a-list-of-users-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» users|body|[string]|true|An array of user URIs for the list of users to follow.|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

> 429 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="follow-a-list-of-users-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The users were followed.|None|
|400|Bad Request|* Error code 2205: The request body is empty.<br>* Error code 2205: The `users` array is invalid.<br>* Error code 2205: The list of users doesn't contain URIs.<br>* Error code 2900: A user in the list doesn't exist.<br>* Error code 2901: The list contains more than 100 users.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|401|Unauthorized|Error code 8000: The user access token is invalid.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|403|Forbidden|Error code 3417: The current user can't follow other users.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Error code 9006: The current user is rate-limited from following other users.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Error code 4005: An unexpected error occurred.|[error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: interact )
</aside>

```bash
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

|---|---|---|---|---|

```json
}
```

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-a-user-has-watched-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

## Delete a user's watch history

<a id="opIddelete_watch_history"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/watched/videos \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /me/watched/videos`

<h3 id="delete-a-users-watch-history-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The watch history was deleted.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: delete )
</aside>

## Delete a specific video from a user's watch history

<a id="opIddelete_from_watch_history"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/watched/videos/258684937 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /me/watched/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="delete-a-specific-video-from-a-users-watch-history-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

<h3 id="delete-a-specific-video-from-a-users-watch-history-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was deleted from your watch history.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: delete )
</aside>

<h1 id="vimeo-videoscomments">Videos\Comments</h1>

## Get all the comments on a video

<a id="opIdget_comments_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/videos/258684937/comments \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.comment+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /channels/{channel_id}/videos/{video_id}/comments`

<h3 id="get-all-the-comments-on-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|

## Add a comment to a video

<a id="opIdcreate_comment_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/videos/258684937/comments \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.comment+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.comment+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "text": "I love this!"
  }'
```

`POST /channels/{channel_id}/videos/{video_id}/comments`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "text": "I love this!"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-comment-to-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» text|body|string|true|The text of the comment.|

## Delete a video comment

<a id="opIddelete_comment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/comments/12345 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /videos/{video_id}/comments/{comment_id}`

<h3 id="delete-a-video-comment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|comment_id|path|number|true|The ID of the comment.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="delete-a-video-comment-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The comment was deleted.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Error code 3415: The authenticated user didn't write this comment and can't delete it.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|404|Not Found|* No such video or comment exists.<br>* Error code 5000: The deleted comment still exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: delete )
</aside>

## Edit a video comment

<a id="opIdedit_comment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/comments/12345 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.comment+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.comment+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "text": "I love this!"
  }'
```

`PATCH /videos/{video_id}/comments/{comment_id}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "text": "I love this!"
}
```

<h3 id="edit-a-video-comment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|comment_id|path|number|true|The ID of the comment.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» text|body|string|true|The next text of the comment.|

## Add a reply to a video comment

<a id="opIdcreate_comment_reply"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/comments/12345/replies \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.comment+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.comment+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "text": "I love this!"
  }'
```

`POST /videos/{video_id}/comments/{comment_id}/replies`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "text": "I love this!"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-reply-to-a-video-comment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|comment_id|path|number|true|The ID of the comment.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» text|body|string|true|The reply to the comment.|

<h3 id="get-all-the-credited-users-in-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The users were returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-all-the-credited-users-in-a-video-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[credit](#schemacredit)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Credit a user in a video

<a id="opIdadd_video_credit_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/videos/258684937/credits \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.credit+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.credit+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "Sam Doe",
    "role": "Producer",
    "user_uri": "/users/152184"
  }'
```

`POST /channels/{channel_id}/videos/{video_id}/credits`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "name": "Sam Doe",
  "role": "Producer",
  "user_uri": "/users/152184"
}
```

<h3 id="credit-a-user-in-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» email|body|string|true|The email address of the credited person.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the credited person.|
|» role|body|string|true|The role of the credited person.|
|» user_uri|body|string|true|The URI of the Vimeo user who should be given credit in this video.|

```json
{
```
