<h3 id="credit-a-user-in-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|The credit was added.|[credit](#schemacredit)|
|400|Bad Request|* The credit was added.<br>* A parameter is invalid.<br>* The authenticated user has an unverified email address.<br>* There is a user block between the video owner and the person receiving credit.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user doesn't own the video.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get all the credited users in a video

<a id="opIdget_video_credits"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/credits \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.credit+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /videos/{video_id}/credits`

<h3 id="get-all-the-credited-users-in-a-video-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|date|

<h3 id="get-all-the-credited-users-in-a-video-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The users were returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-all-the-credited-users-in-a-video-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[credit](#schemacredit)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Credit a user in a video

<a id="opIdadd_video_credit"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/credits \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.credit+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.credit+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "Sam Doe",
    "role": "Producer",
    "user_uri": "/users/152184"
  }'
```

`POST /videos/{video_id}/credits`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "name": "Sam Doe",
  "role": "Producer",
  "user_uri": "/users/152184"
}
```

<h3 id="credit-a-user-in-a-video-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» email|body|string|true|The email address of the credited person.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the credited person.|
|» role|body|string|true|The role of the credited person.|
|» user_uri|body|string|true|The URI of the Vimeo user who should be given credit in this video.|

```json
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="credit-a-user-in-a-video-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|The credit was added.|[credit](#schemacredit)|
|400|Bad Request|* The credit was added.<br>* A parameter is invalid.<br>* The authenticated user has an unverified email address.<br>* There is a user block between the video owner and the person receiving credit.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user doesn't own the video.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get a specific credited user in a video

<a id="opIdget_video_credit"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/credits/12345 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.credit+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /videos/{video_id}/credits/{credit_id}`

<h3 id="get-a-specific-credited-user-in-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|credit_id|path|number|true|The ID of the credit.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

<h3 id="get-a-specific-credited-user-in-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The credit was returned.|[credit](#schemacredit)|
|404|Not Found|No such video or credit exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Delete a credit for a user in a video

<a id="opIddelete_video_credit"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/credits/12345 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /videos/{video_id}/credits/{credit_id}`

<h3 id="delete-a-credit-for-a-user-in-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|credit_id|path|number|true|The ID of the credit.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="delete-a-credit-for-a-user-in-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The credit was deleted.|None|
|400|Bad Request|The authenticated user is neither the creator of the credit nor the credited user.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

## Edit a credit for a user in a video

<a id="opIdedit_video_credit"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/credits/12345 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.credit+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.credit+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Sam Doe",
    "role": "Producer"
  }'
```

`PATCH /videos/{video_id}/credits/{credit_id}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "Sam Doe",
  "role": "Producer"
}
```

<h3 id="edit-a-credit-for-a-user-in-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|credit_id|path|number|true|The ID of the credit.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|The name of the person being credited.|
|» role|body|string|false|The role of the person being credited.|

<h1 id="vimeo-videosembed-privacy">Videos\Embed Privacy</h1>

## Get all the domains on which a video can be embedded

<a id="opIdget_video_privacy_domains"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/privacy/domains \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.domain+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /videos/{video_id}/privacy/domains`

<h3 id="get-all-the-domains-on-which-a-video-can-be-embedded-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "allow_hd": "true",
    "domain": "example.com",
    "uri": "/videos/258684937/privacy/domains/example.com"
  }
]
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="get-all-the-domains-on-which-a-video-can-be-embedded-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The domains were returned.|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|There are no domains on which the video can be embedded.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<h3 id="get-all-the-domains-on-which-a-video-can-be-embedded-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[domain](#schemadomain)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Permit a video to be embedded on a domain

<a id="opIdadd_video_privacy_domain"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/privacy/domains/example.com \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /videos/{video_id}/privacy/domains/{domain}`

If domain privacy is enabled for this video, this method permits the video to be embedded on the specified domain.

<h3 id="permit-a-video-to-be-embedded-on-a-domain-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|The domain name.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="permit-a-video-to-be-embedded-on-a-domain-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video is now embeddable on the domain.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The video doesn't have a user-defined access list.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

## Restrict a video from being embedded on a domain

<a id="opIddelete_video_privacy_domain"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/privacy/domains/example.com \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /videos/{video_id}/privacy/domains/{domain}`

<h3 id="restrict-a-video-from-being-embedded-on-a-domain-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|The domain name.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="restrict-a-video-from-being-embedded-on-a-domain-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was disallowed from being embedded on the domain.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The video isn't set to a user-defined access list.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such domain exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

<h1 id="vimeo-videosessentials">Videos\Essentials</h1>

## Get all the videos in which a user appears

<a id="opIdget_appearances_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/appearances \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/appearances`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-which-a-user-appears-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|filter_embeddable|query|boolean|false|Whether to filter the results by embeddable videos (`true`) or non-embeddable videos (`false`). Required only if **filter** is `embeddable`.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|filter|embeddable|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|comments|
|sort|date|
|sort|duration|
|sort|likes|
|sort|plays|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-which-a-user-appears-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-which-a-user-appears-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get all the videos that a user has uploaded

<a id="opIdget_videos_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/videos \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/videos`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-a-user-has-uploaded-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|containing_uri|query|string|false|The page that contains the video URI. Only available when not paired with `query`.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|filter_embeddable|query|boolean|false|Whether to filter the results by embeddable videos (`true`) or non-embeddable videos (`false`). Required only if **filter** is `embeddable`.|
|filter_playable|query|boolean|false|Whether to filter by all playable videos or by all videos that are not  playable.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|filter|app_only|
|filter|embeddable|
|filter|featured|
|filter|playable|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|comments|
|sort|date|
|sort|default|
|sort|duration|
|sort|last_user_action_event_date|
|sort|likes|
|sort|modified_time|
|sort|plays|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-a-user-has-uploaded-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|
|304|Not Modified|This user hasn't created any videos since the given `If-Modified-Since` header.|None|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-a-user-has-uploaded-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Check if a user owns a video

<a id="opIdcheck_if_user_owns_video_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/videos/258684937 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="check-if-a-user-owns-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|


<h3 id="check-if-a-user-owns-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The user owns the video.|[video](#schemavideo)|
|404|Not Found|The authenticated user doesn't own the video.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get all the videos in which a user appears

<a id="opIdget_appearances"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/appearances \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/appearances`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-which-a-user-appears-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|filter_embeddable|query|boolean|false|Whether to filter the results by embeddable videos (`true`) or non-embeddable videos (`false`). Required only if **filter** is `embeddable`.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|filter|embeddable|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|comments|
|sort|date|
|sort|duration|
|sort|likes|
|sort|plays|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

## Get all the videos that a user has uploaded

<a id="opIdget_videos"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/videos \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/videos`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-a-user-has-uploaded-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|containing_uri|query|string|false|The page that contains the video URI. Only available when not paired with `query`.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|filter_embeddable|query|boolean|false|Whether to filter the results by embeddable videos (`true`) or non-embeddable videos (`false`). Required only if **filter** is `embeddable`.|
|filter_playable|query|boolean|false|Whether to filter by all playable videos or by all videos that are not  playable.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|filter|app_only|
|filter|embeddable|
|filter|featured|
|filter|playable|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|comments|
|sort|date|
|sort|default|
|sort|duration|
|sort|last_user_action_event_date|
|sort|likes|
|sort|modified_time|
|sort|plays|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-a-user-has-uploaded-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|
|304|Not Modified|This user hasn't created any videos since the given `If-Modified-Since` header.|None|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-that-a-user-has-uploaded-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Check if a user owns a video

<a id="opIdcheck_if_user_owns_video"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/videos/258684937 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="check-if-a-user-owns-a-video-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="check-if-a-user-owns-a-video-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The user owns the video.|[video](#schemavideo)|
|404|Not Found|The authenticated user doesn't own the video.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Search for videos

<a id="opIdsearch_videos"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/videos?query=staff%20picks' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /videos`

<h3 id="search-for-videos-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results. `CC` and related filters target videos with the corresponding Creative Commons licenses. For more information, see our [Creative Commons](https://vimeo.com/creativecommons) page.|
|links|query|string|false|A comma-separated list of video URLs to find.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|true|Search query.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|
|uris|query|string|false|The comma-separated list of videos to find.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|filter|CC|
|filter|CC-BY|
|filter|CC-BY-NC|
|filter|CC-BY-NC-ND|
|filter|CC-BY-NC-SA|
|filter|CC-BY-ND|
|filter|CC-BY-SA|
|filter|CC0|
|filter|categories|
|filter|duration|
|filter|in-progress|
|filter|minimum_likes|
|filter|trending|
|filter|upload_date|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|comments|
|sort|date|
|sort|duration|
|sort|likes|
|sort|plays|
|sort|relevant|

```json
  "link": "string"
}
```

> 503 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="search-for-videos-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The search results were returned.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|* Error code 2101: Either the `uris` or `links` parameter has filtering or sorting arguments.<br>* Error code 2204: There is a problem with the batch request.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|503|Service Unavailable|* Search is disabled.<br>* Error code 7300: There was an internal search error.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<h3 id="search-for-videos-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get a specific video

<a id="opIdget_video"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="get-a-specific-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

<h3 id="get-a-specific-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The video was returned.|[video](#schemavideo)|
|404|Not Found|No such video exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Delete a video

<a id="opIddelete_video"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /videos/{video_id}`

<h3 id="delete-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="delete-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was deleted.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The authenticated user doesn't own the video and can't delete it.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: delete )
</aside>

<a id="opIdedit_video"></a>

> Code samples

```bash

  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
```

<h3 id="edit-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» content_rating|body|[string]|false|A list of values describing the content in this video. You can find the full list in the [`/contentratings`](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/endpoints/videos#GET/contentratings) endpoint.|
|» description|body|string|false|The new description of the video.|
|» embed|body|object|false|none|
|» » buttons|body|object|false|none|
|» » » embed|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Embed button.|
|» » » fullscreen|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Fullscreen button.|
|» » » hd|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the HD button.|
|» » » like|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Like button.|
|» » » scaling|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Scaling button (shown only in Fullscreen mode).|
|» » » share|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Share button.|
|» » » watchlater|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Watch Later button.|
|» » color|body|string|false|The main color of the embed player.|
|» » logos|body|object|false|none|
|» » » custom|body|object|false|none|
|» » » » active|body|boolean|false|Show or hide your custom logo.|
|» » » » link|body|string|false|The URL that loads when the user clicks your custom logo.|
|» » » » sticky|body|boolean|false|Whether always to show the custom logo or to hide it after time with the rest of the UI.|
|» » » vimeo|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Vimeo logo.|
|» » playbar|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the playbar.|
|» » title|body|object|false|none|
|» » » name|body|string|false|Show or hide the video title, or enable the user to determine whether the video title appears.|
|» » » owner|body|string|false|Show or hide the owner information, or enable the user to determine whether the owner information appears.|
|» » » portrait|body|string|false|Show or hide the owner portrait, or enable the user to determine whether the owner portrait appears.|
|» » volume|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the volume selector.|
|» license|body|string|false|The Creative Commons license.|
|» locale|body|string|false|The video's default language. For a full list of valid languages, use the [/languages?filter=texttracks](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/endpoints/videos#GET/languages) endpoint.|
|» name|body|string|false|The new title for the video.|
|» password|body|string|false|The password. When you set `privacy.view` to `password`, you must provide the password as an additional parameter.|
|» privacy|body|object|false|none|
|» » add|body|boolean|false|Whether a user can add the video to an album, channel, or group.|
|» » comments|body|string|false|The privacy level required to comment on the video.|
|» » download|body|boolean|false|Whether a user can download the video. Not available to users with a Basic membership.|
|» » embed|body|string|false|The video's new embed settings. The `whitelist` value enables you to define all valid embed domains. See our [documentation](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/endpoints/videos#/{video_id}/privacy/domains) for details on adding and removing domains.|
|» » view|body|string|false|The video's new privacy setting. When privacy is `users`, `application/json` is the only valid content type. Basic users can't set privacy to `unlisted`.|
|» ratings|body|object|false|none|
|» » mpaa|body|object|false|none|
|» » » reason|body|string|false|The reason for the video's MPAA rating.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `at` - Adult themes<br> * `bn` - Brief nudity<br> * `n` - Nudity<br> * `sl` - Strong language<br> * `ss` - Sexual situations<br> * `v` - Violence<br>|
|» » tv|body|object|false|none|
|» » » reason|body|string|false|The reason for the video's TV rating.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `d` - Suggestive dialogue<br> * `fv` - Fantasy violence<br> * `l` - Language<br> * `ss` - Sexual situations<br> * `v` - Violence<br>|
|» review_page|body|object|false|none|
|» » active|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable video review.|
|» spatial|body|object|false|none|
|» » director_timeline|body|[object]|false|The 360 director timeline.|
|» » » pitch|body|number|true|The timeline pitch. This value must be between -90 and 90.|
|» » » roll|body|number|false|The timeline roll.|
|» » » time_code|body|number|true|The 360 director timeline time code.|
|» » » yaw|body|number|true|The timeline yaw. This value must be between 0 and 360.|
|» » field_of_view|body|number|false|The 360 field of view: default 50, minimum 30, maximum 90.|
|» » projection|body|string|false|The 360 spatial projection.|
|» » stereo_format|body|string|false|The 360 spatial stereo format.|

```json
{
```

<h3 id="edit-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The video was edited.|[video](#schemavideo)|
|400|Bad Request|A parameter is invalid.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|403|Forbidden|* The authenticated user doesn't own the video.<br>* The `privacy` field is `disable` and the authenticated user can't set extra embed options.<br>* The `privacy` field is `contacts` and the authenticated user can't follow creators.<br>* The authenticated user has an opted-out PRO account and `privacy.view` is `users`, `password`, `nobody`, or `public`.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

<h1 id="vimeo-videoslanguages">Videos\Languages</h1>

## Get all languages

<a id="opIdget_languages"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/languages \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.language+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /languages`

<h3 id="get-all-languages-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `texttracks` - Only return text track supported languages<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|filter|texttracks|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "code": "en-US",
    "name": "English (United States)"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="get-all-languages-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The languages were returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-all-languages-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[language](#schemalanguage)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

<h1 id="vimeo-videosrecommendations">Videos\Recommendations</h1>

## Get all the related videos of a video

<a id="opIdget_related_videos"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/videos \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /videos/{video_id}/videos`

<h3 id="get-all-the-related-videos-of-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|filter|related|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
```

```json
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="get-all-the-related-videos-of-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The related videos were returned.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|The value of `filter` isn' `related`.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<h3 id="get-all-the-related-videos-of-a-video-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

<h1 id="vimeo-videostags">Videos\Tags</h1>

## Get all the videos with a specific tag

<a id="opIdget_videos_with_tag"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/tags/awesome/videos \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /tags/{word}/videos`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-with-a-specific-tag-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|word|path|string|true|The tag word.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|sort|created_time|
|sort|duration|
|sort|name|

|» page|body|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|» per_page|body|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/videos/258684937/texttracks \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.video.texttrack+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video.texttrack+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \

    "language": "en-US",

    "type": "captions"
  }'
```

`POST /channels/{channel_id}/videos/{video_id}/texttracks`

For additional information, see our [text track upload guide](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/upload/texttracks).

> Body parameter

```json

  "active": "true",
  "language": "en-US",
  "name": "Commentary",
  "type": "captions"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-text-track-to-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Active text tracks appear in the player and are visible to other users. Only one text track per language can be active.|
|» language|body|string|true|The language of the text track. For a complete list of valid languages, use the [/languages?filter=texttracks](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/endpoints/videos#GET/languages) endpoint.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the text track.|
|» type|body|string|true|The type of the text track.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|captions|
|» type|chapters|
|» type|descriptions|
|» type|metadata|
|» type|subtitles|

```json
{
  "active": "true",
  "hls_link": "string",
  "hls_link_expires_time": "1494888499",
  "language": "en-US",
  "link": "string",
  "link_expires_time": "1494888499",
  "name": "English Subtitles",
  "type": "captions",
  "uri": "/videos/258684937/texttracks/12345"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-text-track-to-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|The text track was added.|[text-track](#schematext-track)|
|403|Forbidden|* The authenticated user can't edit the text track.<br>* Error code 2204: The request contains errors.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: upload )

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="delete-a-text-track-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The text track was deleted.|None|
|403|Forbidden|* Error code 3430: You don't have permission to access this text track.<br>* Error code 3431: This text track is disabled.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|404|Not Found|* No such video or text track exists.<br>* The authenticated user can't delete the text track.<br>* Error code 5014: The text track that you specified doesn't exist.<br>* Error code 5015: The text track that you specified belongs to a different video.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: delete )
</aside>

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/videos \
  -X POST \

  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "content_rating": [
      "string"
    ],
    "description": "A celebration of 10 years of Staff Picks.",
    "embed": {
      "buttons": {
        "embed": "true",

        "hd": "true",
        "like": "true",
        "scaling": "true",
        "share": "true",

          "active": "true",
          "link": "https://example.com",
          "sticky": "true"
        },
        "vimeo": "true"
      },
      "playbar": "true",
      "title": {
        "name": "hide",
        "owner": "hide",
        "portrait": "hide"
      },
      "volume": "true"
    },
    "license": "by",
    "locale": "en_US",
    "name": "Celebrating 10 Years of Staff Picks",
    "password": "hunter1",
    "privacy": {
      "add": "true",
      "comments": "anybody",
      "download": "true",

      "view": "anybody"

        "reason": "at"

        "reason": "d"

      "redirect_url": "https://example.com",
      "size": "13623861"
    }
  }'
```

|» » » » link|body|string|false|The URL that loads when the user clicks your custom logo.|
|» » » » sticky|body|boolean|false|Whether always to show the custom logo or to hide it after time with the rest of the UI.|
|» » » vimeo|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Vimeo logo.|
|» » playbar|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the playbar.|
|» » title|body|object|false|none|
|» » » name|body|string|false|Show or hide the video title, or enable the user to determine whether the video title appears.|
|» » » owner|body|string|false|Show or hide the owner information, or enable the user to determine whether the owner information appears.|

<h3 id="upload-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|The upload procedure has begun.|[video](#schemavideo)|
|400|Bad Request|* Error code 2205: The body of the request isn't formatted properly.<br>* Error code 2204: The request contains invalid parameters.<br>* Error code 2204: The request contains invalid body parameters.<br>* Error code 2230: The upload type is invalid.<br>* Error code 3116: If a `type` payload parameter was supplied instead of `upload.approach`.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|401|Unauthorized|Error code 8002: No user is associated with the authentication token.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|403|Forbidden|* Error code 4102: The user's allotted quota has been reached.<br>* Error code 4101: The user's maximum disk space has been reached.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Error code 4003: There is a problem initiating the upload.|[error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: create delete edit email interact private promo_codes public purchase purchased stats upload video_files )
</aside>

## Get a user's upload attempt

<a id="opIdget_upload_attempt"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/uploads/12345 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.uploadattempt+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/uploads/{upload}`

<h3 id="get-a-users-upload-attempt-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|upload|path|number|true|The ID of the upload attempt.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|

<h3 id="get-a-users-upload-attempt-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The upload attempt was returned.|[upload-attempt](#schemaupload-attempt)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: upload )
</aside>

## Complete a user's streaming upload

<a id="opIdcomplete_streaming_upload"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/users/152184/uploads/12345?signature=cd89a20adde7a608f3331e71c37bdfa087bacbf3&video_file_id=1234' \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /users/{user_id}/uploads/{upload}`

<h3 id="complete-a-users-streaming-upload-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|upload|path|number|true|The ID of the upload attempt.|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|signature|query|string|true|The crypto signature of the completed upload.|
|video_file_id|query|number|true|The ID of the uploaded file.|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "developer_message": "The specified resource does not exist.",
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again.",
  "error_code": 5000,
  "link": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="complete-a-users-streaming-upload-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|The streaming upload is complete.|None|
|400|Bad Request|Error code 2502: The format of the video file is invalid.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|404|Not Found|* Error code 5006: The video file doesn't exist.<br>* Error code 5007: The signature doesn't exist.<br>* Error code 8400: The signature is invalid.|[error](#schemaerror)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Error code 4011: The upload server returns an HTTP status code other than 200.|[error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: upload )
</aside>

## Upload a video

<a id="opIdupload_video"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/videos \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "content_rating": [
      "string"
    ],
    "description": "A celebration of 10 years of Staff Picks.",
    "embed": {
      "buttons": {
        "embed": "true",
        "fullscreen": "true",
        "hd": "true",
        "like": "true",
        "scaling": "true",
        "share": "true",
        "watchlater": "true"
      },
      "color": "#1ab7ea",
      "logos": {
        "custom": {
          "active": "true",
          "link": "https://example.com",
          "sticky": "true"
        },
        "vimeo": "true"
      },
      "playbar": "true",
      "title": {
        "name": "hide",
        "owner": "hide",
        "portrait": "hide"
      },
      "volume": "true"
    },
    "license": "by",
    "locale": "en_US",
    "name": "Celebrating 10 Years of Staff Picks",
    "password": "hunter1",
    "privacy": {
      "add": "true",
      "comments": "anybody",
      "download": "true",
      "embed": "private",
      "view": "anybody"
    },
    "ratings": {
      "mpaa": {
        "reason": "at"
      },
      "tv": {
        "reason": "d"
      }
    },
    "review_page": {
      "active": "true"
    },
    "spatial": {
      "director_timeline": [
        {
          "pitch": 70,
          "roll": 0,
          "time_code": 5,
          "yaw": 125
        }
      ],
      "field_of_view": 50,
      "projection": "cubical",
      "stereo_format": "left-right"
    },
    "upload": {
      "approach": "post",
      "link": "https://example.com/video.mp4",
      "redirect_url": "https://example.com",
      "size": "13623861"
    }
  }'
```

<h3 id="upload-a-video-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» content_rating|body|[string]|false|A list of values describing the content in this video. Find the full list in the [/contentratings](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/endpoints/videos#GET/contentratings) endpoint.|
|» description|body|string|false|The description of the video.|
|» embed|body|object|false|none|
|» » buttons|body|object|false|none|
|» » » embed|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Embed button.|
|» » » fullscreen|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Fullscreen button.|
|» » » hd|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the HD button.|
|» » » like|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Like button.|
|» » » scaling|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Scaling button (shown only in Fullscreen mode).|
|» » » share|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Share button.|
|» » » watchlater|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Watch Later button.|
|» » color|body|string|false|The main color of the embed player.|
|» » logos|body|object|false|none|
|» » » custom|body|object|false|none|
|» » » » active|body|boolean|false|Show or hide your custom logo.|
|» » » » link|body|string|false|The URL that loads when the user clicks your custom logo.|
|» » » » sticky|body|boolean|false|Whether always to show the custom logo or to hide it after time with the rest of the UI.|
|» » » vimeo|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the Vimeo logo.|
|» » playbar|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the playbar.|
|» » title|body|object|false|none|
|» » » name|body|string|false|Show or hide the video title, or enable the user to determine whether the video title appears.|
|» » » owner|body|string|false|Show or hide the owner information, or enable the user to determine whether the owner information appears.|
|» » » portrait|body|string|false|Show or hide the owner portrait, or enable the user to determine whether the owner portrait appears.|
|» » volume|body|boolean|false|Show or hide the volume selector.|
|» license|body|string|false|The Creative Commons license.|
|» locale|body|string|false|The video's default language. For a full list of valid languages, use the [/languages?filter=texttracks](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/endpoints/videos#GET/languages) endpoint.|
|» name|body|string|false|The title of the video.|
|» password|body|string|false|The password. When you set `privacy.view` to `password`, you must provide the password as an additional parameter.|
|» privacy|body|object|false|none|
|» » add|body|boolean|false|Whether a user can add the video to an album, channel, or group.|
|» » comments|body|string|false|The privacy level required to comment on the video.|
|» » download|body|boolean|false|Whether a user can download the video. Not available to users with a Basic membership|
|» » embed|body|string|false|The video's embed settings. The `whitelist` value enables you to define all valid embed domains. See our [documentation](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/endpoints/videos#/{video_id}/privacy/domains) for details on adding and removing domains.|
|» » view|body|string|false|The video's privacy setting. When privacy is `users`, `application/json` is the only valid content type. Basic users can't set privacy to `unlisted`.|
|» ratings|body|object|false|none|
|» » mpaa|body|object|false|none|
|» » » reason|body|string|false|The reason for the video's MPAA rating.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `at` - Adult themes<br> * `bn` - Brief nudity<br> * `n` - Nudity<br> * `sl` - Strong language<br> * `ss` - Sexual situations<br> * `v` - Violence<br>|
|» » tv|body|object|false|none|
|» » » reason|body|string|false|The reason for the video's TV rating.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `d` - Suggestive dialogue<br> * `fv` - Fantasy violence<br> * `l` - Language<br> * `ss` - Sexual situations<br> * `v` - Violence<br>|
|» review_page|body|object|false|none|
|» » active|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable video review.|
|» spatial|body|object|false|none|
|» » director_timeline|body|[object]|false|The 360 director timeline.|
|» » » pitch|body|number|true|The timeline pitch. This value must be between -90 and 90.|
|» » » roll|body|number|false|The timeline roll.|
|» » » time_code|body|number|true|The 360 director timeline time code.|

<h1 id="vimeo-videosversions">Videos\Versions</h1>

## Add a version to a video

<a id="opIdcreate_video_version"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/versions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.vimeo.video.version+json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video.version+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "file_name": "untitled.mp4",
    "upload": {
      "approach": "post",
      "link": "https://example.com",
      "redirect_url": "https://example.com",
      "size": "13623861"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /videos/{video_id}/versions`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "file_name": "untitled.mp4",
  "upload": {
    "approach": "post",
    "link": "https://example.com",
    "redirect_url": "https://example.com",
    "size": "13623861"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-version-to-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» file_name|body|string|true|The name of the version|
|» upload|body|object|true|none|
|» » approach|body|string|true|Upload approach|
|» » link|body|string|false|If your upload approach is pull, Vimeo will download the video hosted at this public URL. This URL must be valid for at least 24 hours.|
|» » redirect_url|body|string|false|The app's redirect URL. Use this parameter when `approach` is `post`.|
|» » size|body|string|false|Upload size|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » approach|post|
|» » approach|pull|
|» » approach|streaming|
|» » approach|tus|

## Permit a list of users to view a private video

<a id="opIdadd_video_privacy_users_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/channels/927/videos/258684937/privacy/users \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.user+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /channels/{channel_id}/videos/{video_id}/privacy/users`

The body of this request should follow our
[batch request format](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/common-formats#batch-requests). Each object must contain
a single `URI` field, and the value of this field must be the URI of the user who can view this video.

<h3 id="permit-a-list-of-users-to-view-a-private-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel_id|path|number|true|The ID of the channel.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
```

## Get all the users who can view a user's private videos by default

## Permit a list of users to view a private video

<a id="opIdadd_video_privacy_users"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/privacy/users \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.user+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /videos/{video_id}/privacy/users`

The body of this request should follow our
[batch request format](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/common-formats#batch-requests). Each object must contain
a single `URI` field, and the value of this field must be the URI of the user who can view this video.

<h3 id="permit-a-list-of-users-to-view-a-private-video-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="permit-a-specific-user-to-view-a-private-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The user can now view the private video.|[user](#schemauser)|
|204|No Content|The user can already view this private video.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The video doesn't have a user-defined access list.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

## Restrict a user from viewing a private video

<a id="opIddelete_video_privacy_user"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/videos/258684937/privacy/users/152184 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /videos/{video_id}/privacy/users/{user_id}`

<h3 id="restrict-a-user-from-viewing-a-private-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Something strange occurred. Please try again."
}
```

<h3 id="restrict-a-user-from-viewing-a-private-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The user was disallowed from viewing the private video.|None|
|403|Forbidden|The video isn't set to a user-defined access list.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|
|404|Not Found|No such user exists.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: edit )
</aside>

<h1 id="vimeo-watch-later-queueessentials">Watch Later Queue\Essentials</h1>

## Get all the videos in a user's Watch Later queue

<a id="opIdget_watch_later_queue_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/watchlater \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/watchlater`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-users-watch-later-queue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|filter_embeddable|query|boolean|false|Whether to filter the results by embeddable videos (`true`) or non-embeddable videos (`false`). Required only if **filter** is `embeddable`.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|filter|embeddable|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|comments|
|sort|date|
|sort|duration|
|sort|likes|
|sort|plays|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-users-watch-later-queue-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|
|304|Not Modified|The user hasn't added any videos to their Watch Later queue since the given `If-Modified-Since` header.|None|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-users-watch-later-queue-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: private )
</aside>

## Check if a user has added a specific video to their Watch Later queue

<a id="opIdcheck_watch_later_queue_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/watchlater/258684937 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /me/watchlater/{video_id}`

<h3 id="check-if-a-user-has-added-a-specific-video-to-their-watch-later-queue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

<h3 id="check-if-a-user-has-added-a-specific-video-to-their-watch-later-queue-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The video appears in the user's Watch Later queue.|[video](#schemavideo)|
|404|Not Found|The video doesn't appear in the user's Watch Later queue.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: private )
</aside>

## Add a video to a user's Watch Later queue

<a id="opIdadd_video_to_watch_later_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/watchlater/258684937 \
  -X PUT \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /me/watchlater/{video_id}`

<h3 id="add-a-video-to-a-users-watch-later-queue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

<h3 id="add-a-video-to-a-users-watch-later-queue-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was added.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: interact )
</aside>

## Remove a video from a user's Watch Later queue

<a id="opIddelete_video_from_watch_later_alt1"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/me/watchlater/258684937 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /me/watchlater/{video_id}`

<h3 id="remove-a-video-from-a-users-watch-later-queue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

<h3 id="remove-a-video-from-a-users-watch-later-queue-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was deleted.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: interact )
</aside>

## Get all the videos in a user's Watch Later queue

<a id="opIdget_watch_later_queue"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/watchlater \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/watchlater`

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-users-watch-later-queue-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|direction|query|string|false|The sort direction of the results.|
|filter|query|string|false|The attribute by which to filter the results.|
|filter_embeddable|query|boolean|false|Whether to filter the results by embeddable videos (`true`) or non-embeddable videos (`false`). Required only if **filter** is `embeddable`.|
|page|query|number|false|The page number of the results to show.|
|per_page|query|number|false|The number of items to show on each page of results, up to a maximum of 100.|
|query|query|string|false|The search query to use to filter the results.|
|sort|query|string|false|The way to sort the results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|asc|
|direction|desc|
|filter|embeddable|
|sort|alphabetical|
|sort|comments|
|sort|date|
|sort|duration|
|sort|likes|
|sort|plays|


<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-users-watch-later-queue-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The videos were returned.|Inline|
|304|Not Modified|The user hasn't added any videos to their Watch Later queue since the given `If-Modified-Since` header.|None|

<h3 id="get-all-the-videos-in-a-users-watch-later-queue-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[video](#schemavideo)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: private )
</aside>

## Check if a user has added a specific video to their Watch Later queue

<a id="opIdcheck_watch_later_queue"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/watchlater/258684937 \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.video+json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{user_id}/watchlater/{video_id}`

<h3 id="check-if-a-user-has-added-a-specific-video-to-their-watch-later-queue-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

```json
{
```


<h3 id="check-if-a-user-has-added-a-specific-video-to-their-watch-later-queue-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The video appears in the user's Watch Later queue.|[video](#schemavideo)|
|404|Not Found|The video doesn't appear in the user's Watch Later queue.|[legacy-error](#schemalegacy-error)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: private )
</aside>

## Add a video to a user's Watch Later queue

<a id="opIdadd_video_to_watch_later"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/watchlater/258684937 \
  -X PUT \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /users/{user_id}/watchlater/{video_id}`

<h3 id="add-a-video-to-a-users-watch-later-queue-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

<h3 id="add-a-video-to-a-users-watch-later-queue-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was added.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: interact )
</aside>

## Remove a video from a user's Watch Later queue

<a id="opIddelete_video_from_watch_later"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/152184/watchlater/258684937 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /users/{user_id}/watchlater/{video_id}`

<h3 id="remove-a-video-from-a-users-watch-later-queue-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|number|true|The ID of the user.|
|video_id|path|number|true|The ID of the video.|

<h3 id="remove-a-video-from-a-users-watch-later-queue-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The video was deleted.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2 ( Scopes: interact )
</aside>

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allow_continuous_play|boolean|true|none|Whether an album should allow continuous play.|
|allow_downloads|boolean|true|none|Whether an album should allow downloads.|
|allow_share|boolean|true|none|Whether an album should allow sharing.|
|brand_color|string \| null|true|none|Hexadecimal color code for the decorative color. For example, album videos use this color for player buttons.|
|created_time|string|true|none|The time in ISO 8601 format that the album was created.|
|custom_logo|object \| null|true|none|The custom logo for this album.|
|description|string \| null|true|none|A brief description of the album's content.|
|domain|string \| null|true|none|The custom domain a user has selected for their album.|
|duration|number|true|none|The total duration in seconds of all the videos in the album.|
|embed|object|true|none|Embed data for the album.|
|embed_brand_color|boolean \| null|true|none|Whether to show the album's custom brand color in the player of the album's embedded playlist.|
|embed_custom_logo|boolean \| null|true|none|Whether to show the album's custom logo in the player of the album's embedded playlist.|
|hide_nav|boolean|true|none|Whether to hide the Vimeo navigation when viewing the album.|
|hide_vimeo_logo|boolean \| null|true|none|Whether to hide the Vimeo logo in the player of the album's embedded playlist.|
|layout|string|true|none|The album's layout preference|
|link|string|true|none|The URL to access the album.|
|metadata|object|true|none|Metadata about the album.|
|modified_time|string|true|none|The time in ISO 8601 format when the album was last modified.|
|name|string|true|none|The album's display name.|
|pictures|object|true|none|The active image for the album; defaults to the thumbnail of the last video added to the album.|
|privacy|object|true|none|The privacy settings of the album.|
|resource_key|string|true|none|The album resource key.|
|review_mode|boolean|true|none|Whether album videos should use the review mode URL.|
|sort|string|true|none|Sort type of the album.|
|theme|string|true|none|The album's color theme preference|
|uri|string|true|none|The album's URI.|
|url|string \| null|true|none|The custom Vimeo URL a user has selected for their album.|
|use_custom_domain|boolean|true|none|Whether the user has opted in to use a custom domain for their album.|
|user|object|true|none|The owner of the album.|
|web_brand_color|boolean|true|none|Whether an album should show the brand color in the web layout.|
|web_custom_logo|boolean|true|none|Whether an album's custom logo should be shown in the web layout.|

|name|string|true|none|The display name that identifies the channel.|

|privacy|object|true|none|The privacy settings of the channel.|

|tags|[[tag](#schematag)]|true|none|An array of all tags assigned to this channel.|

|user|object|true|none|The Vimeo user who owns the channel.|

```json
{
  "access_type": "default",

    "connections": {
      "codes": {
        "options": [
          "string"
        ],
        "total": 1,
        "uri": "/ondemand/pages/61326/promotion/12345/codes"
      }
    }
  },
  "percent_off": 100,
  "product_type": "any",
  "stream_period": "1_week",
  "total": 1,
  "type": "batch",
  "uri": "/ondemand/pages/61326/promotions/12345"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|access_type|string|true|none|The type of access that this promotion grants:<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `default` - Grants discounts on existing product offerings.<br> * `vip` - Grants free access either to VOD content before it is released or to access types that aren't part of the existing product offerings.<br>|
|discount_type|string|true|none|The type of discount for which this promotion can be used.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `dollars` - The discount is a certain fixed amount.<br> * `free` - The discount is the full purchase price. VIP access promotions always use this discount type.<br> * `percent` - The discount is a certain percentage of the full price.<br>|
|download|boolean|true|none|Whether this promotion grants download access to On Demand content.|
|label|string \| null|true|none|The prefix string for batch codes, or the null value for single codes.|
|metadata|object|true|none|The video's metadata.|
|percent_off|number|true|none|The percentage amount that is deducted from the product price.|
|product_type|string|true|none|The type of product to which this promotion can be applied. Only `buy` and `rent` are available for the VIP access type:<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `any` - The promotion can be applied to any product.<br> * `buy` - The promotion can be applied to a buyable single video.<br> * `buy_episode` - The promotion can be applied to a buyable single episode.<br> * `rent` - The promotion can be applied to a rentable single video.<br> * `rent_episode` - The promotion can be applied to a rentable single episode.<br> * `subscribe` - The promotion can be applied to a subscription.<br>|
|stream_period|string \| null|true|none|The amount of time that the user has access to the VOD content after redeeming a promo code.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `1_week` - Access lasts for one week.<br> * `1_year` - Access lasts for one year.<br> * `24_hour` - Access lasts for 24 hours.<br> * `30_days` - Access lasts for 30 days.<br> * `3_month` - Access lasts for 3 months.<br> * `48_hour` - Access lasts for 48 hours.<br> * `6_month` - Access lasts for 6 months.<br> * `72_hour` - Access lasts for 72 hours.<br>|
|total|number|true|none|The total amount of times that this promotion can be used.|
|type|string|true|none|The way in which this promotion can generate promo codes:<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `batch` - Provides many unique promo codes that can only be used once each.<br> * `batch_prefix` - Similar to `batch`, except that all codes have a similar prefix string. This mode is deprecated, yet it may still appear for some users.<br> * `single` - Provides a single promo code with many uses.<br>|
|uri|string|true|none|The promotion's canonical relative URI.|

|created_time|string|true|none|The time in ISO 8601 format when the user account was created.|

|description|string \| null|true|none|A brief explanation of the video's content.|
|duration|number|true|none|The video's duration in seconds.|
|embed|object|true|none|Information about embedding this video.|
|height|number|true|none|The video's height in pixels.|
|language|string \| null|true|none|The video's primary language.|
|last_user_action_event_date|string \| null|false|none|The time in ISO 8601 format when the user last modified the video.|
|license|string|true|none|The [Creative Commons](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/) license used for the video:<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `by` - Attribution<br> * `by-nc` - Attribution Non-Commercial<br> * `by-nc-nd` - Attribution Non-Commercial No Derivatives<br> * `by-nc-sa` - Attribution Non-Commercial Share Alike<br> * `by-nd` - Attribution No Derivatives<br> * `by-sa` - Attribution Share Alike<br> * `cc0` - Public Domain Dedication<br>|
|link|string|true|none|The link to the video.|
|metadata|object|true|none|The video's metadata.|
|modified_time|string|true|none|The time in ISO 8601 format when the video metadata was last modified.|
|name|string|true|none|The video's title.|
|parent_folder|object \| null|false|none|Information about the folder that contains this video.|
|password|string|false|none|The privacy-enabled password to watch this video. Only users can see their own video passwords. This data requires a bearer token with the `private` scope.|
|pictures|object|true|none|The active picture for this video.|
|privacy|object|true|none|The video's privacy setting.|
|release_time|string|true|none|The time in ISO 8601 format when the video was released.|
|resource_key|string|true|none|The resource key string of the video.|
|spatial|object|true|none|360 spatial data.|
|stats|object|true|none|A collection of stats associated with this video.|
|status|string \| null|true|none|The status code for the availability of the video. This field is deprecated in favor of `upload` and `transcode`.<br><br>Option descriptions:<br> * `available` - The video is available.<br> * `quota_exceeded` - The user's quota is exceeded with this video.<br> * `total_cap_exceeded` - The user has exceeded their total cap with this video.<br> * `transcode_starting` - Transcoding is beginning for the video.<br> * `transcoding` - Transcoding is underway for the video.<br> * `transcoding_error` - There was an error in transcoding the video.<br> * `unavailable` - The video is unavailable.<br> * `uploading` - The video is being uploaded.<br> * `uploading_error` - There was an error in uploading the video.<br>|
|tags|[[tag](#schematag)]|true|none|An array of all tags assigned to this video.|
|transcode|object \| null|true|none|The transcode information for a video upload.|
|upload|object \| null|true|none|The upload information for this video.|
|uri|string|true|none|The video's canonical relative URI.|
|user|object \| null|true|none|The video owner.|
|width|number|true|none|The video's width in pixels.|
